* Lead client\-facing meetings, presentations, and solution workshops — including engagements with C\-suite and technical decision\-makers — translating technical concepts into executive\-ready business value narratives.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a dedicated pre\-sales team of 5\+ professionals (exclusively pre\-sales, not post\-sales), setting standards for proposal quality, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Collaborate with solution architects and engineering leads to ensure all proposed solutions are technically sound and deliverable.
* Stay updated on current capabilities across **Microsoft Azure**, cloud\-native/MACH architectures, Agentic AI, data engineering, DevOps, and mobile and custom software development.
* Ensure pre\-sales engagements incorporate relevant compliance, security, and governance considerations across key verticals: Fintech, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Retail \& E\-Commerce, Supply Chain \& Logistics, and High\-Tech.
* Track pre\-sales metrics (win rates, proposal quality, deal velocity) and surface insights to sales leadership.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* **8\+ years of experience in pre\-sales**, ideally within a digital engineering, product engineering, or IT services company.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent field.
* Demonstrated experience **leading a pre\-sales team of 5\+ members** in a high\-growth environment.
* Strong working knowledge of:
* **Cloud platforms**: Microsoft Azure
* **Engineering services**: Custom software development, cloud\-native applications, microservices, API development, mobile applications (iOS/Android)
* **Data \& AI**: Data engineering, AI/ML, Agentic AI, LLMs, analytics platforms
* **DevOps**: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud operations
* Excellent proposal writing, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent deals across different industries and solution domains.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Microsoft Azure certifications (particularly in Digital \& App Innovation or Data \& AI) strongly preferred; other cloud or technology certifications a plus.
* Familiarity with Simform's co\-engineering model and agile delivery practices.
* Experience with MACH architecture principles (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, Headless).
* Prior exposure to ISV or enterprise software product development contexts.
* Industry domain expertise in one or more of: Fintech, Healthcare, Retail \& E\-Commerce, or Supply Chain.

**Why Join Us:**


* Young Team, Thriving Culture Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture. Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options

c35b0900.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager
c35b0900.description:
**About Team**
 US Omni Tech at Walmart Global Tech, Bengaluru, is focused on improving Walmart customer experience across both physical \& digital and make Walmart the most exciting place to shop. With 4000\+ brick and mortar stores and thousands of other suppliers fulfilling Walmart's online/in\-store orders for over 1 billion customers \- the challenge and complexity is pronounced! We work within the world’s largest retailer yet maintain a start up feel working in small agile teams to revolutionize the fulfilment landscape. As a leader in the supply chain group, you are accountable and responsible for number of critical products/platforms that helps serve our customers in the most cost\-effective manner in multiple geographies and businesses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development projects.
   

  

 You will work closely with architects and engineering leaders to ensure the successful completion of these projects. To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and contribute to architectural decision\-making processes.
   

  

 You will also need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and project cadences.
   

  

 Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large\-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints.
   

  

 Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy\-in.
   

  

 You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process.
   

  

 Your problem\-solving and decision\-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise.
   

  

 Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
 A bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent.
   

  

 Overall around 18\+years of technical experience with 10\+ years of leadership experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
   

  

 Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
   

  

 Experience supporting and executing a large software portfolio, collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
   

  

 Experienced in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and technologies.
   

  

 Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
   

  

 Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.

**About The Company**
 USEReady helps enterprises apply AI and agentic intelligence to improve decisions, automate operations, and build smarter, more autonomous business systems.
   

  

 For more than a decade, we have built the foundations that make this possible by modernizing BI environments, migrating legacy platforms, improving data quality, and enabling governed, cloud\-first architectures.
   

  

 These foundations now support the next step: AI\-driven insights, automated intelligence, and agent\-powered decision support that reduce complexity and accelerate outcomes.
   

  

 We work closely with technology leaders such as AWS, Elementum, Snowflake, Tableau, Databricks, and others to help organizations modernize analytics, strengthen governance, and deploy agentic automation with confidence.
   

  

 We founded in 2011 and Headquartered in New York City with 450\+ experts across the United States, Canada, India, and Singapore, we serve industries including financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, and retail.
   

  

 Our deep expertise, player\-coach delivery model, and focus on fast, measurable results make us a trusted partner for building an AI\-ready enterprise.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Data Platform \& Analytics Presales Architect with 12\+ years of experience across data engineering, data platforms, analytics, and technical solutioning.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will own the technical solutioning and presales lifecycle for data platform and analytics engagements.
   

  

 This role involves working directly with prospects and business stakeholders, understanding complex data challenges, defining scalable target architectures, developing technical proposals, estimating effort and timelines, and ensuring that solutions proposed during presales are practical, commercially viable, and deliverable.
   

  

 You will work closely with sales, delivery, architecture, and technology teams to shape compelling solutions across modern data platforms, cloud data engineering, analytics, and BI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead technical discovery sessions with CDOs, data leaders, architects, and engineering teams to understand current\-state environments, business challenges, data landscapes, and transformation objectives.
* Translate complex and fragmented environments \- including legacy data warehouses, reporting systems, undocumented data lineage, and disparate data sources \- into scalable and defensible target architectures.
* Own the technical response for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and solution presentations, including architecture, technical approach, assumptions, risks, effort estimates, timelines, and delivery sequencing.
* Design modern data platform and analytics architectures covering data ingestion, transformation, storage, data modeling, semantic layers, orchestration, data quality, governance, and consumption.
* Develop solutions using Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and other modern data architecture patterns.
* Lead and support proofs of concept (PoCs), technical workshops, demonstrations, and solution presentations, focusing on solving complex business and technical challenges.
* Assess and estimate data migration and modernization initiatives, including on\-premises to cloud, SQL Server to Snowflake, legacy warehouse modernization, and migration from legacy BI platforms to modern analytics solutions.
* Develop realistic estimates by considering data volumes, complexity, dependencies, lineage gaps, undocumented business logic, integration requirements, and delivery risks.
* Partner with delivery leadership and engineering teams to ensure that proposed solutions are technically feasible, appropriately staffed, commercially viable, and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to articulate the business value, technical benefits, architecture, implementation approach, and differentiators of proposed solutions.
* Leverage partner technologies and platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Tableau, and Power BI where they provide genuine value to the solution.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to architects, data engineers, and presales team members.
* Participate in client presentations and confidently communicate technical solutions to both executive stakeholders and hands\-on engineering teams.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data platforms, analytics, architecture, or technology consulting.
* At least 5\+ years of experience in solution architecture, technical presales, consulting, or solutioning.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in 2 or more of the following : Snowflake, Databricks , Azure Data Services , AWS Data Services , dbt , Apache Airflow , Apache Spark.
* Strong understanding of modern data architecture and engineering principles, including : 1\. Data Ingestion and Integration 2\. ETL/ELT 3\. Data Warehousing 4\. Lakehouse Architecture 5\. Medallion Architecture 6\. Dimensional Modeling 7\. Data Orchestration 8\. Data Quality 9\. Data Governance 10\. Semantic and Data Consumption Layers.
* Working knowledge of modern BI and analytics platforms, with strong expertise in Tableau or Power BI preferred.
* Proven experience preparing technical estimates, effort sizing, project plans, assumptions, and delivery approaches that were subsequently executed by delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of data migration and modernization programs, including legacy\-to\-cloud and legacy BI modernization.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong client\-facing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with CXO/CDO\-level stakeholders as well as technical engineering teams.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, manage ambiguity, and influence solution decisions.

**Project Role :** 
 Business and Integration Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Designs the integration strategy endpoints and data flow to align technology with business strategy and goals. Understands the entire project life\-cycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, deployment, and operations to ensure successful integration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Downstream Retail Technology
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned Fuels Retail Subject Matter Expert to join our O\&G Downstream Retail Practice within Accenture's Energy Industry Group. The role demands deep end\-to\-end expertise across the downstream fuels retail value chain — from terminal operations and wet stock management through to forecourt technology, pricing, loyalty, and convenience retail. The candidate will lead complex client engagements, drive digital transformation programmes, and serve as the principal domain authority on fuels retail technology implementations across IOCs, NOCs, and independent fuel retail networks.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 E2E Domain Leadership \& Business Process
   

  

 Serve as the go\-to expert across the full downstream retail value chain — terminal receipt \& storage, fuel distribution, forecourt operations, wet stock management, convenience retail, pricing, loyalty, and site compliance.
   

  

 Lead As\-Is / To\-Be process mapping across core fuels retail workflows (O2D, P2P, C2C, Site Operations), facilitating discovery workshops with client operations teams.
   

  

 Produce high\-quality functional specifications, process documentation, and business requirements for use in technology programmes and regulatory submissions.
   

  

 Technology Implementation
   

  

 Act as the business\-side domain expert on fuels retail technology programmes including RFM systems (Verifone, Gilbarco), wet stock platforms (OPW, Implico), SAP IS\-Oil, POS, and loyalty CRM.
   

  

 Translate business requirements into system configurations, integration specifications, and UAT criteria across multi\-site implementations.
   

  

 Own site go\-lives, cutover plans, and post\-implementation stabilisation across large\-scale fuel retail network rollouts.
   

  

 Network Strategy \& Commercial Advisory
   

  

 Advise clients on retail network strategy — site portfolio rationalisation, COCO/CODO/DODO model transitions, throughput benchmarking, and margin optimisation across fuel grades and convenience categories.
   

  

 Conduct pricing strategy reviews and support fuel margin analysis, incorporating competitive benchmarking and demand sensitivity modelling.
   

  

 Support business development pursuits, client proposals, and presentations to C\-suite and senior operations stakeholders.
   

  

 Client \& Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

 Build trusted relationships with C\-suite and senior operations stakeholders at IOCs, NOCs, independent fuel retailers, and PE\-backed networks.
   

  

 Serve as technical lead in client workshops, requirements\-gathering sessions, and steering committee presentations, translating complex operational insights into actionable recommendations.
   

  

 Mentor and guide junior consultants, ensuring quality assurance of deliverables and adherence to project timelines.
   

  

 Innovation \& Digital Transformation
   

  

 Champion the application of GenAI, IoT, and advanced analytics in fuels retail contexts — demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, automated reconciliation, and EV integration.
   

  

 Contribute to Accenture's fuels retail thought leadership, asset commercialisation, and practice\-level knowledge repositories.
   

  

 Develop and deliver knowledge\-sharing programmes, onboarding materials, and training sessions for Accenture delivery teams and client staff.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Fuels Retail Operations


 Expert knowledge of wet stock management, fuel reconciliation, tank gauging, and inventory control using platforms such as OPW, Implico, or Leighton.
   

  

 Deep understanding of forecourt operations, site compliance, HSE requirements, and regulatory frameworks across multiple geographies.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with fuel distribution logistics, terminal operations, and downstream supply chain management.
   

  

 Technology \& Systems
   

  

 Proficient in RFM/POS systems (Verifone, Gilbarco, Wayne), SAP IS\-Oil / SAP S/4HANA downstream modules, and loyalty CRM platforms.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of fuels retail ERP landscapes, system integration patterns, and data flows across the retail value chain.
   

  

 Experienced in UAT design, business readiness assessment, and go\-live cutover management for multi\-site technology rollouts.
   

  

 Commercial \& Network Analysis
   

  

 Proven track record in retail network strategy, site portfolio assessment, COCO/CODO/DODO model analysis, and throughput benchmarking.
   

  

 Skilled in fuel pricing strategy, margin analysis, and competitive benchmarking across fuel grades and convenience retail categories.
   

  

 Experience with financial modelling for retail network investments, including NPV/IRR analysis and scenario planning.
   

  

 Digital \& Data Analytics
   

  

 Practical knowledge of advanced analytics, demand forecasting, and dynamic pricing tools in a fuels retail context.
   

  

 Exposure to GenAI, IoT sensor data, and automation use cases for forecourt operations and wet stock reconciliation.
   

  

 Proficient in data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau) for operational performance reporting and KPI dashboarding.
   

  

 Consulting \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Experienced in multi\-disciplinary team leadership, executive\-level presentations, and cross\-cultural client management across IOC and NOC environments.
   

  

 Strong workshop facilitation skills — business process discovery, requirements elicitation, and design thinking sessions.
   

  

 Capable of producing board\-level deliverables: business cases, operating model designs, and transformation roadmaps.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Downstream Retail Technology.
* Flexible / Remote (Client Site Travel Required) preference for proximity to key energy hubs (London, Houston, Dubai, Singapore).


 Extensive experience collaborating with global consulting and delivery teams comfortable operating across IOC, NOC, and PE\-backed fuel retail environments
   

  

 10\+ years in O\&G Downstream / Fuels Retail with focus on operations, technology implementation, or network strategy exposure to EV charging integration is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Results\-driven with strong commercial acumen able to communicate complex operational concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences trusted advisor capability at C\-suite level.
   

  

 Relevant industry certifications (SAP, PMP, TOGAF) advantageous active participation in NACS, APEA, or equivalent fuels retail industry bodies preferred.
   

  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

 , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a
 **single platform** 
 , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
   

  

 As part of a fast\-moving,
 **multi\-year transformation** 
 , the team will stabilize near\-term operations,
 **migrate core** 
**platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally** 
 , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with
 **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** 
 on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
   

  

 For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help
 **build a new business unit from its earliest days** 
 , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain
 **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership** 
 , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
   

  

**HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption\-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.**
****What You’ll Do:****
**Workstream\-Specific Details**
****Responsibilities****
* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for services and software subscription offers across the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios, spanning quote, order, fulfillment, entitlement, and renewal.
* Translate subscription and SaaS commercial constructs — term, usage\-based, committed\-consumption, co\-term, and mid\-term change — into platform\-level design on the target L2C stack.
* Design and document subscription data models, product/offer structures, and integration patterns between CPQ, order management, entitlement, billing, and asset management systems.
* Partner with business, product, and pricing leaders to pressure\-test offer designs for feasibility, then define the architecture runway required to deliver them.
* Lead design reviews and architecture decision records; resolve cross\-workstream dependencies and drive alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Guide migration of subscription and support contracts from fragmented legacy systems onto the unified platform, including data mapping, reconciliation, and cutover design.
* Support build and test teams as the design authority — clarifying intent, reviewing configuration, and triaging defects that trace to architectural decisions.
* Identify and escalate architectural risks, technical debt, and scalability constraints with recommended mitigations to program leadership.


****Education And Experience Required****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution or application architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Lead\-to\-Cash, CPQ, order management, or subscription billing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience architecting services and software subscription offers (SaaS, term license, consumption\-based, and support/services contracts) at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CPQ, Oracle, Zuora, or comparable subscription and order management systems.
* Track record on large\-scale transformation, ERP/CRM migration, or post\-merger integration programs, including legacy data migration and cutover.
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment with onshore/offshore delivery teams.
* Relevant architecture or platform certifications (e.g., TOGAF, SAP, Salesforce) an asset.


****What You Need To Bring:****
**Knowledge And Skills**
* Deep knowledge of subscription commercial models — term, usage, committed consumption, co\-term, ramp, renewal, and mid\-term change — and how they are represented in system design.
* Strong command of quote\-to\-cash process design across CPQ, contracting, order orchestration, entitlement, provisioning, billing, and revenue recognition.
* Solid grasp of integration architecture: APIs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and master data management across product, customer, and install\-base domains.
* Ability to produce clear architecture artifacts — solution designs, data models, interface specifications, and decision records — that development teams can build from.
* Analytical and structured problem solver, comfortable making design decisions with incomplete information and revisiting them as the program matures.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to executives and business stakeholders in plain language.
* Collaborative working style with the credibility to act as design authority across multiple workstreams and vendors.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the pace of a multi\-year integration program.

648998dd.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
648998dd.description:
**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

eef90a4a.title: IDM - Technical Architect (Saviynt).
eef90a4a.description:
Location: Remote (India or Eastern Europe)
 



 Timezone: CET to IST Timezone
 



 Experience: Minimum 10 years
 



 Employment Type: Contract (12 months)
 



 Start Date: Immediate Start
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 For our Global client (strong presence in Europe), we are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to support the transition of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to Saviynt. The role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, business application knowledge, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills to ensure a successful migration and adoption across the enterprise.
 



  





 The successful candidate will work closely with application owners, business stakeholders, security teams, and external vendors to design, implement, and support identity governance and access management solutions during the transformation program.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Support the migration of Identity and Access Management capabilities from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to Saviynt.
* Collaborate with business application owners to understand access management requirements and integration needs.
* Design, configure, test, and implement IAM solutions and access governance processes within Saviynt.
* Lead application onboarding activities for enterprise systems including SAP, Veeva, Employee Central (SuccessFactors), and other business\-critical applications.
* Analyze existing roles, entitlements, provisioning workflows, and access control models to support migration and optimization.
* Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, HR, Compliance, and Business teams to ensure alignment with security and regulatory requirements.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), defect resolution, and production deployment activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, process flows, integration specifications, and operational procedures.
* Provide technical guidance and best practices related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
* Support post\-migration stabilization activities and continuous improvement initiatives.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Minimum 7 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), or related security domains.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) and/or Saviynt implementations and migrations.
* Strong understanding of user lifecycle management, provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, access certifications, and segregation of duties concepts.
* Experience integrating and supporting enterprise business applications such as: SAP, Veeva, Employee Central (SuccessFactors), Other HR, ERP, CRM, or regulated business applications
* Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and application owners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and vice versa.
* Experience working in global and cross\-functional environments.

**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**About the Role:**


The Sr Manager of Connectivity, Cloud and Automation serves as the enterprise leader for security‑focused cloud networking, global connectivity platforms, and automation engineering. This role defines and drives the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of next‑generation network security, cloud connectivity, DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms, automation frameworks, and reliability engineering practices.

  



**What You'll Do:**


**Strategic Leadership \& Architecture**


* Define and own the enterprise strategy for network security, cloud networking, connectivity platforms, and automation.
* Establish target‑state architectures across firewalls, cloud networking, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, observability, automation, and connectivity services.
* Align enterprise cloud, identity, and zero trust security standards.

  

**Security \& Cloud Networking**


* Check Point \& Cisco Firepower, F5 LTM/GTM/APM, NAC, AWS networking, Zero Trust integrations.
* Lead strategy and lifecycle of firewalls, IDS/IPS, URL filtering, and NAC.
* Oversee cloud networking for AWS and hybrid cloud environments.
* Drive Zero Trust integrations.

  

**Connectivity Platform \& Automation**


* DNS/DHCP/IPAM (Infoblox), Public DNS \& Domains, Akamai GTM/Geo, certificate management, automation (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git), observability, reliability engineering, SRE practices, ITSM/ITIL stewardship.
* Own DNS, DHCP, IPAM, domain services, global traffic management.
* Lead automation strategy using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Git.
* Implement observability and SRE frameworks.
* Manage digital certificate lifecycle.

  

**Vendor \& Platform Management**


* Lead strategic vendor partnerships and contract optimization.
* Ensure global platform resiliency and service delivery.

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Ensure network availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive automation, AIOps, and reliability improvements.
* Lead governance representing Connectivity, Security, Automation services.

  

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders on Network technology strategy and design.
* Collaborate with global teams across Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure \& Operations.
* Represent Network in global governance forums and architecture boards.
* Mentor engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and accountability

  



**What You'll Bring:**


* 12\+ years in network security, cloud networking, or connectivity architecture, with 5\+ years leading teams
* Expertise in firewalls, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud networking (AWS), DNS/DHCP/IPAM, load balancing, NAC, and automation
* Experience leading global platform engineering and modernization
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with budget management and business case development / investment justification
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Engineering or Computer Science required
* Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred
* People management, coaching, and development experience required
* Strategic and analytical thinker with the ability to balance vision with execution
* Collaborative and inclusive leader who fosters global teamwork and shared accountability
* Continuous learner with curiosity about emerging technologies and their business impact
* Strong communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and simplify complex technical narratives
* Ownership mindset – accountable for technology / architecture integrity and driving measurable business outcomes

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**


* CCNA \- Cisco Certified Network Technician/Cisco Certified Network Architect Required
* AWS Certified Solution Architect/AWS Advanced Networking Required
* CCNP \- Cisco Certified Network Professional/Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Preferred
* CCDP \- Cisco Certified Design Professional Preferred
* CISSP Certified Information Systems Security Professional Preferred
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Preferred

  

**Physical Demands Category:** Corporate Office


* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  



**Travel**


* Domestic: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.


* International: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.

* Influencing others

* Negotiating with others with long\-term strategic importance to the business

* Outside of PVH

* Sets objectives for self and others and delivers results that impacts the organization

d74b4b11.title: Delivery Lead
d74b4b11.description:
**Job Title:** 
 Delivery Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Only Chennai\- Hybrid(4 days/week). Not open for other locations at this point
 



**Duration:** 
 Full time
 



**Notice period:** 
 Immediate to 60 days max
 



**Budget:** 
 Open to discuss
 



  





 ⚠️ Important Note
 



**Please do not apply if you have interviewed with Mastech Digital within the past 3 months.** 
 Duplicate/recent interview profiles may not be considered for this opportunity.
 



  





  





**Role Summary** 




*The Delivery Lead (known as Delivery Manager in other organizations) sits between the Delivery Partner and Project Manager in the delivery hierarchy — owning end\-to\-end delivery of Data \& Analytics programs for one or more client accounts, depending on account size, and ensuring governance, quality, and strong client stakeholder relationships. This is a generic role deployed across verticals; specific vertical experience is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of D\&A programs for one or more client accounts, scaling scope with account size and complexity
* Drive program planning, execution tracking, and milestone management across owned accounts
* Embed standardized delivery and automation practices across each account



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary client\-facing point of contact for delivery matters on owned accounts
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and proactively manage expectations
* Lead delivery governance forums (status reviews, steering committees) with client leadership



  





**Governance, Quality \& Risk** 



* Ensure delivery governance and quality standards are met across engagements
* Proactively identify delivery risks and drive mitigation and escalation as needed
* Deliver scalable, insight\-driven solutions aligned to client business outcomes



  





**Team \& Project Management Oversight** 



* Direct and mentor Project Managers/project leads within owned accounts, providing delivery direction beyond single\-project execution
* Manage delivery estimation, staffing, and financial performance for assigned accounts
* Track utilization, billing milestones, and margin across owned accounts
* Escalate portfolio\-level risks, resourcing gaps, or growth opportunities to the Delivery Partner where applicable



  





**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** 



* Strong delivery management experience on analytics/D\&A projects
* Client\-facing experience with senior stakeholders
* Working knowledge of cloud data ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP data platforms)
* Solid grounding in delivery governance, estimation, and financial management
* Demonstrated hands\-on delivery ownership, not just program oversight
* Experience directing or mentoring Project Managers, or a track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams/accounts



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Domain experience in Financial Services \& Payments (FSP) — e.g., SOX, PCI\-DSS, Basel, banking/payments data ecosystems — is a plus
* Domain experience in Healthcare — e.g., HIPAA, HL7/FHIR, payer/provider analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Retail — e.g., merchandising, supply chain, or customer/loyalty analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Manufacturing — e.g., Industry 4\.0, IoT/OT data, supply chain or quality analytics — is a plus
* PMP, Agile/Scrum, or Scaled Agile (SAFe) certification
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP data or analytics track)
* Experience with delivery reporting/tooling (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Tableau)



  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field
* 12–18 years of overall experience, including meaningful experience managing and delivering analytics/D\&A projects, with hands\-on client\-facing delivery ownership



  





**Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months** 



* Strong client relationship established; delivery predictability visibly improved
* Account governance cadences (steering committee, status reporting) fully operational
* Standardized delivery practices and playbooks embedded across owned account(s)



  





**\*\*\*Profiles We Are Not looking at This Point\*\*\*** 



* Pure PMO or BI\-developer profiles without delivery ownership
* Profiles without hands\-on delivery ownership or client interfacing experience
* No prior exposure to Data \& Analytics engagements

d7b744f8.description:
**Job Summary**
 Senior Solution Engineer within NetApp's Sales organization, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth by aligning NetApp's technology solutions with customer business objectives and leading technical sales engagements across a high\-value account portfolio.
   

  

 This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role offering significant opportunities for career growth and exposure to strategic enterprise customers. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, consultative selling skills, executive presence, and the ability to build lasting relationships with customers, partners, Client Executives, and Sales Leaders.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

* Partner with Client Executives to develop and execute account strategies that drive revenue growth and market expansion.
* Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and C\-level executives.
* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, requirements, and business objectives.
* Architect, demonstrate, and position NetApp solutions aligned to customer outcomes.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, including solution design, POCs, validation, and closure.
* Collaborate with channel partners and internal teams to drive opportunities and achieve territory goals.
* Present NetApp’s technology vision, value proposition, and competitive differentiation.


 Job Requirement
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience in presales, solutions consulting, or sales engineering.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise storage, data protection, disaster recovery, and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills.
* Experience influencing enterprise technology buying decisions and driving technical wins.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Minimum 15 years of experience in Technical Presales, Solution Engineering, or a related customer\-facing technology role.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate degree or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.


 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. **Company Description** 
 Edifice Medical Technologies is a solutions provider specializing in equipment and technology for hospital infrastructure, operating rooms, and surgical environments. The company offers integrated operating rooms, nurse call communication systems, pneumatic tube systems, modular OTs, tracking solutions, and hospital furniture from leading global and regional brands. Its portfolio also includes advanced surgical devices such as OT lights, OT tables, pendant systems, and bipolar coagulators for neurosurgery, sourced from manufacturers across Europe and Asia. Edifice Medical Technologies further supports sterile processing departments with high\-performance pulsed IR sterilizers. Candidates joining the organization can expect to work with cutting\-edge medical technologies that improve clinical workflows and patient care.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site role for a Presales and Application Engineer based in Mumbai. The role involves engaging with prospective and existing hospital clients to understand their clinical and infrastructure requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations for operating room, surgical, and sterilization solutions. The Presales and Application Engineer collaborates with the sales team to design solution configurations, support tenders, and provide technical clarifications during the sales cycle. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include coordinating for Demonstration of Equipment, presales planning and designing, installation requirements with engineering teams, conducting functional testing of equipment, training users on product operation, and offering application support to ensure optimal performance. The role also includes documenting customer feedback, assisting with product evaluations, and contributing to continuous improvement of solutions and presales materials.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Technical Support skills, including troubleshooting, customer interaction, and after\-sales application support.
* Candidates should possess Electrical / Mechanical Engineering skills for understanding and supporting electrical systems and interfaces in hospital equipment.
* Candidate should have working on Autocad drawing.
* Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clinical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work on\-site in hospital environments, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively with sales and engineering teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Biomedical, Mechanical, or related field) or an equivalent technical qualification.
* Experience in medical devices, hospital infrastructure, or healthcare technology is an advantage.

 **AgentOps Team**

**Why Join AgentOps?** 



  

  


 This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.
 


  

  


 You will:
 


  

  
* Build cutting\-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.
 


  

  


 As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI\-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  


**Business Analysis \& Opportunity Discovery**

* Human review and approval stages
  

  
* Escalation paths
  

  
* Exception handling
  

  
* Feedback loops
  

  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  

  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  

  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  


  


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership** 



  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  

  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  

  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.

132a4f96.description:
Solution Architect (DFS)
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Senior Forward Deployment Engineer – GCP Agentic AI**

  

**Job Type**Full\-Time  

  

**Experience**8–12 years overall; at least 3 years in Generative AI / Agentic AI with significant enterprise production delivery on Google Cloud  

  

**Locations**Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore, Pune  

  

**Primary Focus**Solution architecture, customer technical leadership, production strategy, technical governance and FDE leadership
  

**Role Overview**
=================


We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) to lead the technical architecture and end\-to\-end deployment of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for strategic customers on Google Cloud. The Senior FDE is a customer\-facing solution architect who can code: they own the technical success of the customer engagement, make architecture and deployment decisions, lead customer workshops, review implementation, drive production readiness, and mentor FDEs.


* Customer\-facing solution architect who can code
* Owns technical success of the customer engagement
* Makes architecture and production decisions
* Leads FDEs and influences the platform roadmap
  

**Typical time allocation**

* \~50% architecture and technical leadership
* \~30% customer leadership
* \~20% engineering oversight and mentoring
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the overall technical delivery of enterprise Agentic AI deployments from discovery and architecture through production rollout, hypercare, and transition to BAU.
* Lead customer discovery, technical workshops, architecture reviews, executive technical discussions, solution demonstrations, POCs, pilots, and production planning.
* Design customer\-specific AI and cloud architectures using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, ADK, Google Cloud services, enterprise data sources, applications, security controls, and operational services.
* Define agent architecture including multi\-agent patterns, Planner/Critic/Supervisor/Orchestrator designs, domain agents, Skills, tools, RAG, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, state, and enterprise integrations.
* Define the integration architecture for REST APIs, MCP tools, databases, ITSM platforms, monitoring systems, identity systems, messaging systems, and proprietary applications.
* Decide which requirements should be implemented through configuration, customer\-specific extensions, or reusable platform capabilities; drive the appropriate engineering path.
* Define production deployment architecture across Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM, Secret Manager, networking, and other appropriate Google Cloud services.
* Define production architecture requirements for availability, scalability, security, resiliency, observability, release management, rollback, disaster recovery, and operational support.
* Lead security and identity architecture discussions covering IAM, RBAC, service accounts, authentication, authorization, secrets management, data protection, auditability, and network controls.
* Define and review production readiness criteria covering functionality, security, performance, reliability, evaluation, observability, governance, supportability, and operational readiness.
* Define the customer AgentOps strategy including telemetry, tracing, logging, metrics, evaluation, quality monitoring, cost monitoring, and operational dashboards.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for production issues involving agents, models, RAG, tools, integrations, networking, authentication, and cloud infrastructure.
* Drive reliability, latency, scalability, model performance, and AI cost optimization across customer deployments.
* Define and review CI/CD, release management, environment promotion, versioning, rollback, and deployment processes.
* Review architecture, integration code, deployment plans, and technical deliverables produced by FDEs; establish engineering quality standards.
* Mentor and technically guide FDEs and Associate FDEs working on customer deployments.
* Establish reusable deployment patterns, integration patterns, reference architectures, runbooks, onboarding standards, and troubleshooting playbooks.
* Identify recurring customer requirements and drive their conversion into reusable agents, Skills, tools, connectors, frameworks, and platform capabilities with Agent Development / Platform Engineering teams.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues and major production incidents.
* Provide technical feedback to Product, Agent Development, Platform Engineering, Security, Cloud Architecture, and Operations teams and influence platform roadmap priorities.
* Lead technical handover, customer enablement, operational readiness, and transition to support/BAU teams.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Must Have Skills**
====================


* Strong Python and software engineering skills with the ability to review and guide production code.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, evaluation, and multi\-agent architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with ADK and/or LangGraph/LangChain in production.
* Strong Google Cloud architecture and engineering experience with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform / Google Cloud AI services.
* Strong enterprise integration experience across REST APIs, databases, ITSM platforms, monitoring systems, identity platforms, and customer\-specific applications.
* Strong understanding of IAM, OAuth, service accounts, RBAC, secrets management, authentication, authorization, security, and enterprise networking.
* Strong experience with containerized applications, Docker, Cloud Run, GKE, and production deployment patterns.
* Strong experience with CI/CD, Git, release management, versioning, and production operations.
* Strong experience with observability, tracing, logging, monitoring, debugging, evaluation, and production incident management.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, knowledge integration, retrieval, evaluation, and agent quality measurement.
* Experience with Responsible AI, guardrails, AI security, data protection, and enterprise governance.
* Strong customer\-facing communication skills and ability to lead architecture conversations with senior technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
====================


* Deep experience with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform capabilities including ADK, Agent Runtime, Agent Gateway, Model Armor, Agent Evaluation, and Cloud Observability.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry and enterprise AgentOps practices.
* Experience with MCP, A2A, and enterprise agent interoperability.
* Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure\-as\-Code and enterprise cloud landing zones.
* Strong experience with GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, networking, and private connectivity.
* Experience with ServiceNow, ITSM, CloudOps, SRE, AIOps, infrastructure automation, or enterprise operations.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure production architectures.
* Experience leading POCs, pilots, MVPs, production rollouts, and strategic enterprise deployments.
* Exposure to multiple cloud platforms is advantageous.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Qualifications**
==================


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 8–12 years of overall software engineering, cloud engineering, solution architecture, or equivalent technical experience.
* At least 3 years of practical Generative AI / Agentic AI experience.
* Demonstrated track record of delivering multiple enterprise technology or AI solutions into production.
* Demonstrated customer\-facing technical leadership and architecture ownership.

**Key Attributes**
==================

d0647675.description:
**Location:** Worli, Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Designation:** Architectural BIM Coordinator (Manager)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5\+ Years

**About BIMTECH SERVICES LLP**

BIMTECH SERVICES LLP is a specialized BIM and digital construction services firm supporting the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry. Our expertise includes Building Information Modelling (BIM), digital construction, BIM implementation, training, and workflow automation.

We are seeking an experienced Architectural BIM Coordinator (Manager) to lead architectural BIM development, multidisciplinary coordination, documentation, and BIM project delivery. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, consultants, and BIM teams to ensure high\-quality models and coordinated project deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Architectural BIM Development \& Coordination

* Lead architectural BIM development using Autodesk Revit across various project stages and defined Levels of Development (LOD).
* Review BIM models for design intent, accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project requirements.
* Coordinate architectural models with Structural, MEPF, Interior Design, and other disciplines.
* Identify, communicate, and resolve design and coordination issues.

**2\. Architectural Documentation \& Deliverables**

* Oversee the preparation of plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, and construction documentation.
* Review drawings and BIM deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project standards.
* Manage drawing revisions, annotations, sheet organization, and documentation workflows.
* Support project delivery through design development, tender, and construction stages.

**3\. BIM Content \& Revit Families**

* Develop and manage custom Revit families, including doors, windows, furniture, façade components, and other architectural elements.
* Maintain Revit templates, family libraries, view templates, schedules, and annotation standards.
* Provide technical guidance on complex architectural geometry and efficient BIM modelling practices.

**4\. Model \& Design Collaboration**

* Manage BIM workflows using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) Docs and Design Collaboration.
* Coordinate model sharing, publishing, version control, and consultant inputs.
* Ensure model integrity, data consistency, and effective collaboration between design and BIM production teams.

**5\. Multidisciplinary Coordination \& Clash Detection**

* Conduct model reviews and clash detection using Navisworks Manage.
* Coordinate architectural elements with Structural and MEPF systems.
* Prepare coordination issues and reports and monitor their resolution.
* Participate in coordination meetings with architects, engineers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.

**6\. Team Management \& Project Delivery**

* Supervise and guide Architectural BIM Engineers and Modelers.
* Allocate tasks based on project priorities, deadlines, and team capacity.
* Monitor project progress, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Identify technical challenges and workflow bottlenecks and provide appropriate solutions.
* Report project status, pending inputs, coordination issues, and upcoming deliverables to management.
* Support continuous improvement and standardization of BIM processes.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* B.Arch. or equivalent architectural qualification.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Architectural BIM development and coordination.
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit Architecture, including modelling, documentation, work sharing, and family creation.
* Working knowledge of Navisworks Manage and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
* Strong understanding of architectural design development and construction documentation.
* Experience in multidisciplinary BIM coordination.
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings, specifications, consultant inputs, and project requirements.
* Experience in leading or mentoring BIM teams.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem\-solving, and project management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Candidates with experience in the following will be preferred:

* BIM Execution Plans (BEP)
* ISO 19650 standards and BIM workflows
* Dynamo and Revit automation
* Autodesk Forma
* Rhino or similar design/BIM software
* Large\-scale residential, commercial, high\-rise, institutional, or mixed\-use projects
* BIM standards, templates, libraries, and process development

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for a technically strong BIM professional who can take ownership of architectural BIM coordination, lead teams, maintain project quality, and collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate a strong understanding of Revit\-based architectural BIM, multidisciplinary coordination, construction documentation, and BIM project delivery.

**Interested candidates are requested to share:**

* Updated CV
* Relevant Project Portfolio
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period

**Email: hr@bimtechllp.com**

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Ensures technology solutions align with business needs, emphasizing usability, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness.

* Strong grasp of SFCC Core Concepts: Mastery of SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI is essential.

* Agile/Scrum: Experience delivering scalable UI within fast\-paced Agile environments.

  


 

**Education:**

 **Skills:**

* Experience with 3rd Party tools like Optimizely, Content stack


* Experience with Mocha for automated testing.

* Languages: JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, JSON, SCSS.


* SFCC: PWA Kit, Composable Storefront, SCAPI, OCAPI, Business Manager, SLAS.


* Frontend: React (Expert), TypeScript, Node.js, CSS\-in\-JS (Chakra UI).


* Quality/DevOps: SonarQube, Git, Jira, Postman, Managed Runtime (MRT).

*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Technical Architect will support the full implementation lifecycle, from prioritizing to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. Be responsible for efficiently designing and building the Salesforce industry\-specific Financial Services Cloud, Healthcare Cloud, revenue cloud. It also requires maintaining an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud\-computing ecosystem. Technical Architects typically specialize in a salesforce platform (e.g. Force.com (Sales, Service, Community, IoT, Einstein Clouds), Marketing Cloud, Commerce, and Health Cloud), and developing solutions cross\-cloud is becoming more critical.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Working closely with Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects, and if required directly with clients to devise technology solutions to meet client needs and ensure the software product is used accurately and the go\-forward solution is easy to maintain and meets standard processes. This includes a lead role in project discovery and definition workshops, supplying crafting scope and development estimates, and documenting requirements and designs.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Collaborate with internal team members (sales/pre\-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers increase the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services.
* Designing ground\-breaking technical solutions and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry\-standard methodologies.
* Leading and mentoring the development and QA teams on the project.
* Application design, development, and support of Salesforce\-related projects. The candidate must demonstrate dynamic leadership in the full life cycle of the software development environment.
* Through the use of UML diagrams, design documentation, and best\-practice methodologies; detailed design of Salesforce\-related projects from inception through production support.
* Responsible for ensuring that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business unit, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance requirements are closely supervised by working with the development teams.
* Responsible for creating, and delivering, in a timely and accurate fashion, CRMs and workflow solutions using Salesforce/Apex, Force, Visualforce, and J2EE technologies.
* Advocate and implement standard process development methodology to drive quality delivery of enterprise solutions. Develop POCs or help customers and partners with complex coding tasks.
* Identify and lead internal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; contribute to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 2\+ years of experience in handling client\-facing projects in positions of increasing responsibility in the context of systems development and related business consulting.
* Handling multiple projects/issues, Coaching Architects, Strong Industries background.
* Demonstrated Ability in Financial Services domain/Healthcare domain/Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud domain.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
* Experience in designing and developing software components and having a very strong Service Oriented Architecture and integration background. Specializes in gathering and analyzing information and designing comprehensive solutions that meet best practice standards and the client's needs.
* Experience in Salesforce (SFDC) CRM with end\-to\-end implementation experience.
* Salesforce.com integration experience, including between different business systems as well as working with integration tools.
* Proficiency in programming using Salesforce SFDC, Force.com, APEX, J2EE, HTML, Java, JavaScript, and XML and their use in the development of CRM solutions.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, programming with APEX APIs, APEX Triggers, and implementing new instances of Salesforce.com from scratch.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, and programming with Lightning Aura Components.
* Knowledge in LWC.
* Strong practical deployment knowledge of VisualForce, Flex, Salesforce configurations, Apex classes, APEX Web services, API, AppExchange deployment, and Salesforce.com controls.
* Ability to define the system landscape, identify gaps between current and desired end\-states, and deliver a CRM solution.
* Additional Salesforce.com experience includes Workflow Alerts and Actions, and Approval Workflow.
* Experience leading teams in the analysis of complex problems, and the design and implementation of related solutions.
* Diligent with the ability to learn quickly to demonstrate new concepts, technologies, and solutions.
* Ability to work independently and be a self\-starter.
* A pioneering innovator who continually studies new technologies and functionality, and is involved in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies.
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed (average of 30\-50%), but may be higher or lower based on the engagement.
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between.  **Senior Specialist or Developer II** 
 to join the
 **GDC** 
 team in our
 **SAP** 
 practice.
