c4ae720c.description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼** 
**We're Nagarro.**
 We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000\+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non\-hierarchical. We're looking for great new colleagues. That's where you come in!
   

  

**Job Description**
**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Total Experience:7\.5\+ years
* Should be able to lead end\-to\-end Salesforce Health Cloud solution architecture and delivery for large, enterprise healthcare implementations.
* Deep expertise in Health Cloud features, including Patient/Member Profiles, Care Plans, Care Programs, Care Teams, Health Timelines, Assessments, Care Gaps, and Utilization Management. Strong leadership in translating complex healthcare business requirements into scalable Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
* Should be able to drive architectural decisions covering Salesforce core, Health Cloud extensions, integrations, data models, and automation.
* Should have hands\-on leadership experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Triggers, Batch Apex, and Salesforce APIs.
* Should be able to define and govern integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7\.
* Must have strong understanding of EHR/EMR integrations, payer/provider workflows, and patient/member lifecycle management.
* Should be able to lead all phases of the delivery lifecycle requirements, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Provide technical governance, conduct design/code reviews, and manage architectural risks and technical debt.
* Should be able to lead and mentor multi\-shore Salesforce teams, including developers, admins, QA, and offshore delivery teams.
* Should have hands\-on experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Copado, Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins.
* Should be able to collaborate closely with program managers to manage scope, timelines, risks, and delivery commitments.
* Should be able to drive innovation and continuous improvement, including PoCs, adoption of new Salesforce Health Cloud features, and platform enhancements.
* Should be able to participate in roadmap planning, release strategy, and long\-term platform evolution discussions.
* Must have strong experience working in Agile / Scaled Agile environments, supporting sprint planning and release management.
* Excellent communication, leadership, decision\-making, and stakeholder management skills.
* Mentoring the team members to meet the client's needs and holding them accountable for high standards of delivery.
* Being able to understand and relate technology integration scenarios and be able to apply these learnings in complex troubleshooting scenarios.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Understanding the client’s business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
* Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
* Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the client’s requirements.
* Own overall Health Cloud technical strategy, ensuring scalability, security, and compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA/PHI).Showcasing a consulting mindset by acting as a solution provider rather than an order taker.
* Act as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders, architects, and senior leadership on Health Cloud capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve high\-level and low\-level technical designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Ensure adoption of Salesforce best practices, governor limit optimization, performance tuning, and code quality standards.
* Guide teams on Salesforce security model, data access, sharing rules, consent management, and compliance needs.
* Identifying project/service stakeholders at an early stage and working with them to ensure that the
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and Salesforce technical teams.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Architects and Developers to design scalable, best\-practice solutions.
* Validate solution feasibility against Salesforce platform capabilities and project constraints.
* Prepare and maintain process flows, business process models, functional diagrams, and documentation.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to users by explaining Salesforce capabilities and solution trade\-offs.
* Support user adoption through training materials, user guides, and release notes.
* Analyze existing Salesforce implementations and recommend process improvements and optimization opportunities.
* Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation
* Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high\-level design of the application for the developers
* Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
* Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non\-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it
* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects
* Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
* Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

91157de4.title: AGM - Solution Delivery
91157de4.description:
Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on\-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
   

  

 VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
   

  

 VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Lead the delivery, development, maintenance, and operational support of assigned BSS IT applications, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high\-quality technology solutions aligned with business and IT priorities. Drive end\-to\-end execution across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models, with accountability for platform stability, service availability, production rollouts, and timely L2/L3 incident resolution. Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and vendors to manage risks, improve operational efficiency, and enable continuous technology modernisation.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as the technology and BSS domain SME for Telecom Billing and Bill Presentment application, ensuring solution feasibility and effective translation of business requirements into scalable technology outcomes.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of change requests, enhancements, and projects across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models, ensuring adherence to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business priorities.
* Review solution designs, product backlogs, low\-level designs, development approaches, testing strategies, and release plans to ensure alignment with system capabilities, enterprise architecture, cost objectives, and technology roadmaps.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, IT teams, partners, and vendors for requirements clarification, effort validation, delivery planning, issue resolution, and timely completion of project milestones.
* Drive stable 24x7 operations for business\-critical BSS platforms by monitoring availability, uptime, service performance, operational KPIs, business transaction trends, and technical success/failure patterns.
* Manage L2/L3 production support, incident resolution, problem management, root\-cause analysis, MTTR reduction, and SLA adherence for critical business services and platform operations.
* Ensure disciplined adherence to IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, release, deployment, post\-production validation, and service assurance governance.
* Identify and implement automation, proactive monitoring, alarm optimisation, process improvements, and technology modernisation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, resiliency, and service reliability across the BSS portfolio.
* Ability to assess solution design, integration dependencies, non\-functional requirements, performance, availability, security, privacy, and operational resilience Application \& platforms.


**Competency**
**Functional Competencies:** 
 Strong understanding of telecom revenue management processes, including activation, provisioning, rating, charging, billing, collections, disputes, product catalogue, bill presentment, revenue assurance, and downstream financial workflows.
   

  

**Technical Competencies:** 
 Working knowledge of billing and charging platforms (Viz 6D and Amdocs Billing Suites), Aurion Pro Bill presentation and formats \[PS, PDF, XML], Understanding of Mobility and Fixed line data and voice products \[Viz, ILL IPLC, ITFS, cloud telephony etc], DevOps tools and technologies Jenkins/GitLab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Java technologies, Middleware’s \[IBM WebSphere, Wildfly etc.] , Databases \[Oracle, Single Store etc] and ITIL aligned operations in a distributed architecture setup.
   

  

**Technical/Professional Qualification**
* BE / B\-tech / MCA degree in IT/Technology
* Sound knowledge of Agile/DevOps frameworks/methodology and Tools
* Sound Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle)
* Industry certification like ITIL, PRINCE2, CSM, PMP
* Technical degree from Premium institute will be an added advantage


 Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Competent in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Word.
   

  

**Vodafone Idea Limited** 
 (formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
   

  

 An Aditya Birla Group \& Vodafone partnership

6e92fd02.title: Cloud Support Engineer
6e92fd02.description:
**Cloud Support Engineer** 




**A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India cloud support team** 




**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
 



**About the Company** 




 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India cloud support team and has partnered with Flexiple to bring on cloud support engineers. You will be one of the first cloud specialists on the ground, shaping how the company supports customers running its product across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and deployment issues for customers, working closely with engineering to keep their environments stable and performant.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Cloud Troubleshooting \& Support** 



* Diagnose and resolve customer\-reported issues across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Investigate deployment failures, connectivity issues, and performance bottlenecks
* Reproduce issues in test environments and document root causes clearly



**Reliability \& Product Partnership** 



* Partner with engineering to escalate and close out complex cloud issues
* Contribute to runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal cloud documentation
* Share recurring customer patterns with product to influence the roadmap



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 2 to 6 years in cloud support, DevOps support, or site reliability roles
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Comfort with Linux administration and basic scripting in Python or Bash
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote\-work setup



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP associate level or higher)
* Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product



**What We Offer** 



* A founding cloud\-support seat with a high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct exposure to engineering leadership and product decisions
* One application considered for this and future matched roles



**Hiring Process** 




 HR Screening → Technical Assessment → Hiring Manager Round → Culture Fit

62fdd755.description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




  

 The purpose of the role is to create exceptional product architectural design for the existing and new products and enable delivery teams to provide exceptional client engagement and satisfaction.
   

  
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* **Develop architectural designs for the new and existing products** 
	+ Define product requirements and design needs by displaying complete understanding of product vision and business requirements
		- Understand market\- driven business needs and objectives; technology trends and requirements to define architecture requirements and strategy
		- Create a product\-wide architectural design that ensures systems are scalable, reliable, and compatible with different deployment options
		- Develop theme\-based Proof of Concepts (POCs) in order to demonstrate the feasibility of the product idea and realise it as a viable one
		- Analyze, propose and implement the core technology strategy for product development
		- Conduct impact analyses of changes and new requirements on the product development effort
	+ Provide solutioning of RFPs received from clients and ensure overall product design assurance as per business needs
		- Collaborate with sales, development, consulting teams to reconcile solutions to architecture
		- Analyse technology environment, enterprise specifics, client requirements to set a product solution design framework/ architecture
		- Provide technical leadership to the design, development and implementation of custom solutions through thoughtful use of modern technology
		- Define and understand current state product features and identify improvements, options \& tradeoffs to define target state solutions
		- Clearly articulate, document and sell architectural targets, recommendations and reusable patterns and accordingly propose investment roadmaps
		- Validate the solution/ prototype from technology, cost structure and customer differentiation point of view
		- Identify problem areas and perform root cause analysis of architectural design and solutions and provide relevant solutions to the problem
		- Tracks industry and application trends and relates these to planning current and future IT needs
	+ Provides technical and strategic input during the product deployment at the client site

90f108bb.title: Azure Data Architect
90f108bb.description:
Azure Data Architect
Pune, Maharashtra
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Azure Data Solutions Architect leads the design and implementation of enterprise\-scale data solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics. This role provides architectural leadership, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business strategy and industry best practices. The architect drives innovation, enforces governance, and mentors teams to deliver high\-quality, future\-ready data platforms that support organizational transformation.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement scalable data architectures using Azure services
* Build and optimize **ETL/ELT pipelines** using Azure Databricks and **Apache Spark**
* Architect data lake and data warehouse solutions using **Azure Data Lake** and **Azure Synapse Analytics**
* Define data modeling strategies (batch \& real\-time processing)
* Ensure data security, governance, and compliance standards
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data workloads
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows
* Mentor and guide data engineers and development teams
* Integrate advanced analytics, AI, and ML solutions when required
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Strong experience with **Azure Databricks** and Spark (PySpark/Scala)
* Hands\-on experience with Azure services (ADF, ADLS, Synapse, Event Hub)
* Expertise in big data architecture and distributed systems
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Python, and data engineering concepts
* Experience with data modeling techniques (star schema, dimensional modeling)
* Understanding of real\-time streaming (Kafka/Event Hub)
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices
  

**Strong Development Area:**

**Data Engineering Foundations**  

Batch vs streaming; lakehouse concepts; medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold); file formats (Parquet/Delta/CSV/JSON/Avro); partitioning \& clustering; schema evolution; data governance basics; DevOps/CI\-CD for data.


**SQL**  

Joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, set operations; aggregation \& rollups; MERGE/UPSERT; analytic functions; performance (indexes, partition pruning, statistics); data validation scenarios (dedupe, top\-N, SCD keys).


**Apache Spark (Core)**  

Spark architecture (driver/executors), DAG, stages/tasks; RDD vs DataFrame/Dataset; wide vs narrow transformations; shuffle mechanics; caching/persistence; partitioning; broadcast joins; skew handling; checkpointing; job tuning.


**PySpark**  

DataFrame API, Spark SQL; UDF vs pandas UDF; windowing; incremental loads; structured streaming (triggers, watermarks); handling semi\-structured data; optimizing with predicates, pushdown, join strategies; error handling; unit testing (pytest \+ chispa).


**Databricks Platform**  

Workspace basics; clusters (Single Node/All\-Purpose/Jobs), cluster policies; DBR/LTS; notebooks \& Repos; Jobs \& Workflows; Delta Lake \& Delta Live Tables; Unity Catalog (catalog/schema/table, permissions, lineage); MLflow basics; secret scopes; DBFS; REST APIs; Databricks Connect.


**Delta Lake / Lakehouse Patterns**  

ACID transactions; schema enforcement/evolution; time travel; OPTIMIZE/ZORDER; VACUUM; CDC patterns (MERGE INTO, change data feed); streaming vs batch Delta; expectations/constraints; table maintenance strategies.


**Orchestration \& Scheduling**  

Databricks Workflows; Azure Data Factory/Synapse pipelines; triggers; parameter passing; fail/retry; alerts; integration with AutoSys/Control\-M/Jenkins/GitHub Actions; event\-driven patterns.


**Python (Core for Data)**  

Core syntax; typing \& data structures; file I/O; logging; virtual environments; packaging; testing (pytest); common data libs (pandas, pyarrow); error handling; performance considerations (vectorization, generators).


**Data Quality \& Testing**  

Great Expectations/dbx expectations or custom checks; unit/integration tests; reconciliation (row/amount); anomaly detection; contract testing for schemas; data observability (metrics, SLAs, freshness).


**Security \& Governance**  

Unity Catalog permissions, row/column\-level security; secrets management (Key Vault/Secret scopes); PII handling; audit logs; token management; compliance basics.


**Cost \& Performance Optimization**  

Cluster sizing, autoscaling; DBU awareness; spot/preemptible instances; storage formats; caching; efficient joins; job scheduling; monitoring with metrics \& Ganglia/Spark UI; cost tagging and chargeback.


**Analytical Skills \& Problem Solving**  

Break down data problems; root\-cause incidents; propose alternatives; estimate complexity; communicate clearly with stakeholders.


**Stake Holder Management**  

Interaction with Client Stakeholders, Communication.


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Recommended)
  

2\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (Optional But Valuable

b229be58.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Cloud Architect based in India.**
 This is a senior cloud architecture role providing technical leadership across cloud architecture, engineering, operations, and modernization initiatives. You will help define and execute cloud strategy across multi\-cloud environments while establishing standards for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective solutions. The role combines strategic architecture with hands\-on technical leadership across cloud platforms, infrastructure, networking, security, containers, and automation. You will lead complex migration and modernization programs while partnering with engineering, security, research and development, enterprise architecture, and business teams. A strong focus on infrastructure as code, DevOps, governance, reliability, and continuous improvement will be central to the role. You will also influence executive\-level technology decisions and help shape the evolution of global technology platforms.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Serve as a cloud architecture subject matter expert, providing strategic direction, governance, technical leadership, and architectural guidance across cloud platforms and services.
* Design, deploy, and support secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and other cloud environments.
* Lead complex cloud initiatives from strategy and architecture through implementation, coordinating with project managers, engineers, vendors, and service providers.
* Define and maintain cloud architecture standards, design patterns, operational procedures, technology roadmaps, and governance practices.
* Establish and optimize multi\-cloud operational support models, including processes, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and service management practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, research and development teams, security teams, and enterprise architects to develop integrated cloud solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Lead and guide cloud migration initiatives, including application modernization and large\-scale infrastructure transitions.
* Champion infrastructure as code, automation, DevOps, and cloud governance practices to improve engineering efficiency, consistency, and delivery.
* Assess architectural and operational risks and develop mitigation strategies supporting business continuity, security, compliance, resilience, and operational excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement across cloud performance, reliability, security, scalability, disaster recovery, backup, retention, and cost optimization.
* Provide technical recommendations to senior stakeholders and translate complex business requirements into scalable, sustainable cloud architectures.
* Mentor technical teams and contribute to the adoption of emerging technologies, open\-source solutions, and modern cloud engineering practices.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; an advanced degree and relevant cloud certifications are preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise cloud solutions.
* Professional\-level certification in AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud technologies.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale cloud transformation and migration programs.
* Deep expertise in cloud architecture, infrastructure operations, networking, storage, virtualization, containers, security, and governance.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and Azure in enterprise environments.
* Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes, VMware, and containerized application platforms.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies, including Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, Python, GitLab, and Azure DevOps.
* Experience designing high\-availability, disaster recovery, backup, retention, and resilient infrastructure architectures.
* Strong understanding of cloud security frameworks, vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and security best practices.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Windows, database technologies, and IT service management practices.
* Experience working with Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and clear executive\-level recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on technical excellence and operational reliability.
* Passion for emerging technologies, open\-source innovation, cloud transformation, and continuous learning.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation.
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Employee assistance and wellness programs.
* Life and disability insurance.
* Full\-time, fully remote position based in India.
* Opportunity to lead enterprise\-scale cloud transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to multi\-cloud environments spanning AWS, Azure, and related technologies.
* Opportunity to work across cloud architecture, DevOps, infrastructure automation, security, governance, and reliability.
* Collaboration with engineering, security, enterprise architecture, research and development, business, and external technology partners.
* Opportunity to influence cloud strategy, technical standards, and long\-term technology roadmaps.
* Exposure to emerging technologies and open\-source innovation.
* Opportunity to mentor technical teams and contribute to continuous engineering improvement.

About Us :
 
 Cardinality.ai is the modernization alternative that innovative states are using to better serve citizens. Over 5000 caseworkers across 13 government agencies, 11 states, 12 nonprofits and healthcare providers are already using Cardinality.ai pre\-built solutions.
 




  






 Cardinality is a software company, founded in 2017, helping government agencies achieve better outcomes through artificial intelligence and the strategic use of data.
 




  






 Our solutions — engineered for health and human services programs — deliver enhanced efficiency and improve the lives of citizens. Together with our agency customers, we achieve remarkable outcomes for families
 




  






 Job Overview:
 




  






 We are seeking a high\-energy, technically adept Presales Consultant with 3–5 years of experience in the SaaS or IT Services domain. In this role, you will act as the crucial bridge between our technical capabilities and client requirements, driving technical discovery, solution design, high\-converting demo presentations, and strategic pitch sessions for enterprise prospects.
 





 The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of software architectures and cloud solutions, paired with exceptional storyboarding and presentation skills. Prior experience supporting Orals presentations for US State, Local, or Federal Government (GovTech) prospects is highly preferred.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 





 Solution Architecture, Storyboarding \& Demonstrations
 





 Technical Discovery: Partner with Sales teams to lead discovery calls, unearthing technical pain points, security requirements, and business goals.
 





 Deck \& Demo Content Creation: Build visually compelling, customized slide decks and interactive demo flows tailored to the prospect’s specific pain points and industry context.
 





 Tailored Demos: Work with Product team to prepare and deliver high\-impact product demonstrations that clearly articulate complex technical features into intuitive business value for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 





 Proof of Concept (PoC): Scope, design, and manage PoCs and technical trials to validate value propositions for prospective clients.
 




  






 Pitching \& Orals Support
 





 Orals Demonstration Support: Play a pivotal role in preparing for and executing formal "Orals" presentations, especially for competitive enterprise and public sector evaluations.
 





 Demo Environment Preparation: Configure and maintain realistic, tailored demo environments that simulate real\-world customer workflows and showcase key differentiators during live presentations.
 





 GovTech Alignment: Tailor presentation narratives and technical slide decks to align with US public sector priorities, compliance nuances, and procurement expectations.
 




  





  






 Strategic Collaboration
 





 Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the customer by providing structured feedback from sales presentations to Product and Engineering teams to help shape the product roadmap.
 





 Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Professional Services and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless handover post\-sale.
 




  






 Requirements \& Qualifications
 





 Experience: 3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Presales Consultant, Solution Architect, or Technical Sales Engineer in B2B SaaS or IT Services.
 





 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
 





 GovTech / Orals Experience (Preferred): Track record of supporting live Orals presentations, pitch defense sessions, or shortlist demos for US State/Local/Federal government or enterprise deals.
 





 Technical \& Deck Building Skills:
 





 Proficiency in creating clean, visual, and narrative\-driven pitch decks (PowerPoint, Google Slides).
 





 Strong technical foundation in cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), REST APIs, integrations, and enterprise SaaS deployment models.
 





 Familiarity with data security, compliance standards (e.g., SOC2, FedRAMP, HIPAA), and identity management (SSO, SAML).
 





 Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to confidently present to C\-suite executives, public sector evaluation committees, and technical teams.
 





 Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work overlapping hours with US time zones (EST).

69b2cfca.title: Architect
69b2cfca.description:
**Position:** Architect – Design \& Project Coordination  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Real Estate Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Qualification:** B.Arch / M.Arch  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a **Architect – Design \& Project Coordination** to support the planning, design development and execution of residential and real estate development projects.

The role will involve working closely with senior management, design consultants, structural and MEP consultants, project teams, contractors and other stakeholders to translate project requirements into functional, commercially viable and execution\-ready architectural solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong architectural fundamentals, hands\-on experience in design and documentation, good understanding of construction and real estate development, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Architectural Design \& Planning**

* Develop and support conceptual, schematic and detailed architectural designs for residential and real estate projects.
* Prepare and review plans, elevations, sections, layouts, area statements and architectural details.
* Support master planning, space planning, unit planning, amenity planning and overall project design development.
* Evaluate design options based on functionality, aesthetics, constructability and project requirements.
* Translate project briefs and business requirements into practical architectural solutions.

**2\. Design Development \& Documentation**

* Prepare detailed working drawings, construction drawings and GFC documentation.
* Develop architectural details, schedules, specifications and drawing packages.
* Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, constructability and design intent before issue.
* Maintain drawing registers, revisions and project documentation.
* Ensure timely delivery of drawings and design\-related deliverables as per project schedules.

**3\. Consultant \& Design Coordination**

* Coordinate with structural, MEP, landscape, interior, façade and other specialist consultants.
* Review and integrate consultant drawings with architectural requirements.
* Identify design conflicts and coordination issues and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Participate in design coordination and project review meetings.
* Track design changes, approvals and outstanding technical requirements.

**4\. Site \& Execution Coordination**

* Conduct regular site visits to monitor architectural execution against approved drawings and specifications.
* Review site conditions and provide design clarifications wherever required.
* Coordinate with project managers, contractors and site teams on architectural matters.
* Review shop drawings, material samples and technical submissions where required.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and support timely resolution of site issues.
* Ensure design intent, quality and architectural standards are maintained during execution.

**5\. Statutory \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support compliance with applicable building regulations, development control norms and statutory requirements.
* Assist with area calculations, FSI/FAR, setbacks, parking and other planning parameters.
* Coordinate with approval consultants and relevant stakeholders for statutory submissions and approvals.
* Maintain awareness of applicable local regulations and development norms, particularly for Hyderabad projects.

**6\. Project \& Design Reviews**

* Participate in design review meetings with senior management, consultants and project teams.
* Prepare presentations, design proposals and project updates for internal reviews.
* Evaluate design changes with respect to functionality, cost, timelines and project objectives.
* Support value engineering and design optimisation initiatives without compromising project quality.

**7\. Real Estate Development Support**

* Provide architectural inputs during feasibility and early\-stage project planning.
* Support evaluation of development potential through planning studies, area analysis and design options.
* Work with the Strategy, Projects, Sales, Marketing and other teams to ensure the product is aligned with market and project requirements.
* Contribute to design decisions that improve customer experience, project positioning and overall development value.

Candidate Profile

* **3–5 years of professional experience** in architecture, preferably with a real estate developer, architectural consultancy, PMC or construction organisation.
* **B.Arch / M.Arch** from a recognised institution.
* Experience in **residential, high\-rise, premium/luxury residential, commercial or large\-scale real estate projects** will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of architectural design, construction documentation and project execution.
* Ability to independently handle design development and architectural coordination for assigned project components.
* Good understanding of building planning, construction materials, architectural detailing and site execution.
* Working knowledge of applicable building bye\-laws and statutory approval processes.
* Knowledge of **Hyderabad real estate development regulations / GHMC / HMDA / DTCP processes** will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work within project timelines.

Technical Skills

**Must Have:**

* AutoCAD
* MS Office – particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Architectural working drawings and documentation
* Construction detailing
* Consultant coordination

**Preferred:**

* Revit / BIM
* SketchUp
* Lumion / Enscape / V\-Ray or similar rendering software
* Photoshop / Adobe Creative Suite
* Knowledge of BIM\-based coordination workflows

Preferred Experience

Candidates with exposure to the following will be preferred:

* Residential / high\-rise developments
* Premium or luxury real estate projects
* Master planning and large\-scale developments
* GFC and construction documentation
* Site execution and architectural coordination
* Consultant management
* Statutory approvals and development regulations
* FSI/FAR and area calculations
* Design optimisation and value engineering
* End\-to\-end project lifecycle from design through execution

Key Competencies

**Architectural Design \| Design Development \| Working Drawings \| GFC Documentation \| Real Estate Development \| Consultant Coordination \| Site Coordination \| Building Regulations \| Project Planning \| Construction Detailing \| Design Review \| Problem Solving \| Stakeholder Management**

Pay: Up to ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The SAP ERP Solution Consultant is a part of SAP experts supporting Roche Clinical Supply operations (PTDS). You will lead independently complex SAP solution delivery (ECC and S4\) in the area of Production Planning and Process (PP\-PI), proactively solve product issues, and contribute to architecture. In this role, you will drive SAP solutions, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product\-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report to the Team Lead of ERP Clinical Supplies and Advanced Therapies
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Works independently to deliver ERP solutions in the area of PP\-PI and proactively identifies and addresses challenges. Seeks senior colleague support for complex product scenarios while ensuring adherence to processes for timely and high\-quality results. Contributes to specific chapter\-related outcomes,fosters effective teamwork, and actively solicits ideas from others within the project team.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Deals with uncertainty and makes decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.
* Stakeholder Management: Primarily interacts within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable.Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.
* Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to a specific workgroup or project.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to prioritize and report status at the product level.
* Business / Technical ability: Applies a basic understanding of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Demonstrates good knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis and Consultancy concepts and practices.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience in regulatedpharmaenvironments, including CSV and data privacy concepts, change management, documentation and testing.
* Demonstrated 5\+ years experience working and leading independently to deliver complex solution designs and products within the SAP ERP area \-SAP PP\-PI.
* Strong background ininterfaces, integration through idocs and APIs.
* Proficiency in Logistics Execution (LE) and Sales\& Distribution (SD) is preferred.
* Proven track record of driving the successful completion of major implementations or changes in SAP ECC/S4 area, frequently functioning in a leadership or tech lead role.
* Strong preference for candidates with SAP life cycle solutions experience (e.g. ICSM, CGT/TMP).
* Ability to organize your work, proactively seek knowledge and work independently.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Expert knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis / Consultancy concepts and practices in the area of PP\-PI.
* Strong knowledge of external integrations with with ECC and S/4
* Good knowledge of LE/SD/WM is an advantage.
* Basic understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Basic to intermediate level of pharmaceutical process knowledge.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong collaborative mindset with a track record of actively soliciting ideas from project team members.
* Solid stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of interacting on small to medium engagements and articulating the business impact of their work.


**Shift:** CET Timezone
  
\#Hyderabad2026

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.

1a5929c2.title: Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect
1a5929c2.description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.


**Job Description:**

**Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect \- AI Solutions** with strong expertise in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation.

  

  

This is a hands\-on engineering role for an experienced software developer who combines strong technical design skills with recent experience building and deploying AI\-powered applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, contributing to software development, and implementing modern AI capabilities that align with our product and solution offerings.

  

  

As a Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, leadership teams, clients, data scientists, consultants, DevOps engineers, and software engineers to design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications and AI\-driven solutions. You will play a key role in translating complex business problems into scalable technical solutions while ensuring engineering excellence, maintainability, and long\-term product success.

  

  

**Job Responsibilities**

* Partner with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, design end\-to\-end solutions, and help Product Owners break down initiatives into actionable user stories and technical deliverables.
* Design and develop scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions that can be integrated into existing products and strategic solution offerings.
* Actively contribute to software development, code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Drive solution design decisions while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, performance, and operational requirements.
* Leverage strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to understand complex business challenges and develop innovative AI\-powered solutions.
* Champion engineering best practices, coding standards, testing strategies, and quality metrics across development teams.
* Integrate and optimize data from various internal and external systems, understanding the challenges associated with enterprise data integration across SaaS applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain APIs, services, and integrations that support enterprise applications and AI solutions.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability of applications and AI systems.
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data quality, availability, and successful deployment of AI and machine learning capabilities.
* Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines, processing frameworks, and supporting infrastructure required for AI and machine learning workloads.
* Build and deploy AI\-powered applications utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI orchestration patterns.
* Apply prompt engineering techniques and AI best practices to improve the quality, relevance, and reliability of generative AI solutions.
* Communicate technical solutions, risks, and recommendations effectively to leadership, business stakeholders, and clients.
* Stay current with advancements in software engineering, AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies, recommending practical innovations for our products and operations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, resolve complex technical challenges, and foster a collaborative engineering culture.
  

  

**Requirements / Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering background with proven experience designing and developing enterprise\-scale applications.
* Demonstrated experience designing technical solutions and participating in architecture reviews, system design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and Java with strong experience building APIs, services, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and deploying Generative AI solutions in production environments.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, MCP, A2A, and modern AI application development patterns.
* Experience working with NLP frameworks and machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services including Azure and/or AWS.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices including CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, AKS, EKS, GitHub Actions, and containerized deployments.
* Experience building modern user interfaces using React, Bootstrap, and related frameworks.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience working with Snowflake, Databricks, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of Data Integration, ETL, Data Quality, Data Discovery, and enterprise data management concepts.
* Experience integrating third\-party and enterprise APIs.
* Familiarity with metadata management tools and data governance concepts.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage clients, business stakeholders, leadership teams, and engineering organizations.

Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors:


* **Location\-based market rate** for the role
* **Your abilities** in relation to the job specification
* **Performance** during screening and interview
* **Pay parity** with the wider team in the considered location

Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent Acquisition Team.

  


**Epiq Leadership Compass**

**Fosters Relationships \& Collaboration**

Builds trust and alignment through open communication, shared goals, and strong partnerships to drive collective success.


* Build trust\-based partnerships
* Nurture long\-term relationships
* Remove collaboration barriers
* Celebrate cross\-team success

**Engages \& Influences**

Inspires action and alignment through clear communication, purposeful influence, and a compelling vision.


* Use storytelling to build buy\-in
* Align communication with organizational goals
* Guild alignment through strong engagement

**Maximizes Performance**

Sets and reinforces performance standards that drive results, ensure accountability, and align with Epiq’s goals.


* Use data to identify improvement opportunities
* Make informed decisions
* Align team goals with boarder strategy
* Empower teams to manage their own goals
* Translate vision into clear priorities
* Prepare for disruptions with strong change management

**Achieves Operational Success**

Drives continuous improvement and operational excellence through smart processes, data insights, and quality execution.


* Improve workflows for team efficiency
* Use clear documentation and expectations
* Resolve issues quickly using data and feedback

**It is Epiq’s policy to comply with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws by making all employment decisions without unlawful regard or consideration of any individual’s race, religion, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, transgender status, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, marital status, age, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran or family status or any other basis protected by applicable national, federal, state, provincial or local law. Epiq’s policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on any of these impermissible bases, as well as any bases or grounds protected by applicable law in each jurisdiction. In addition Epiq will take affirmative action for minorities, women, covered veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. Epiq is pleased to provide such assistance and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. Pursuant to relevant law, where applicable, Epiq will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.**

3c54ca87.title: Solution Engineer _ BA ( Immediate Joiner, 2+Yrs, WFO)
3c54ca87.description:
**Company Description** 
 eShipz is a fast\-growing logistics automation platform that helps brands streamline shipping operations and deliver seamless post\-purchase experiences. The platform offers modules for multi\-carrier shipping, real\-time tracking, NDR management, returns, freight audit, and more, enabling businesses to manage logistics efficiently at scale. With features such as automated shipping labels, real\-time alerts, analytics and reporting, and reliable customer support, eShipz supports both eCommerce and enterprise clients. Over 350 businesses trust eShipz to simplify and optimize their logistics workflows across carriers and channels.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Solution Engineer – BA role at eShipz is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. In this role, the professional will work closely with clients to understand business requirements, translate them into functional and technical specifications, and configure eShipz solutions to meet those needs. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collaborating with product and development teams, supporting integrations with customer systems and carriers, performing solution demos, and assisting with presales and implementation activities. The role also involves troubleshooting issues, optimizing workflows, documenting processes, and ensuring a smooth transition from onboarding to ongoing support for immediate and new customers.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong software development and system integration understanding, with the ability to work with APIs, data mapping, and technical workflows.
* Candidates should possess consulting and business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process documentation, and solution design aligned to logistics operations.
* Candidates should possess sales and presales capabilities, such as conducting demos, supporting proposals, and collaborating with sales teams to address customer needs.
* Candidates should possess integration\-focused skills, including coordinating with technical teams and external partners to ensure successful end\-to\-end solution deployment.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, and 2\+ years of experience in solution engineering, business analysis, or a similar role.
* Additional beneficial skills include knowledge of logistics or eCommerce domains, strong communication and stakeholder management, analytical problem\-solving, and readiness to join immediately.

5872c1c2.title: Implementation Architect
5872c1c2.description:
**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**
**About AppViewX:**
 AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
   

  

* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** 
 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** 
 We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
   

  

**What will you be responsible for?**
 Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.
   

  

**Onboarding**
* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**
* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**
* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


**Roadmap Planning**
* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on PKI, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
+ Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices

* Hands on experience with:
+ Kubernetes
+ Linux / Windows server management
+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise

* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**
 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
   

  

 AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

a5b71282.description:
***Solutions Architect \- Data Engineering***




  





 Modern tech solutions advisory \& 'futurify' consulting as a Searce lead fds (‘forward deployed solver’) architecting scalable data platforms and robust data engineering solutions that power intelligent insights and fuel AI innovation.
 



 If you’re a tech\-savvy, consultative seller with the brain of a strategist, the heart of a builder, and the charisma of a storyteller — we’ve got a seat for you at the front of the table.
 



**You're not a sales lead. You're the transformation driver.** 




  





**What are we looking for** 




*real solver?* 




**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.** 
 We're searching for the architects of the audacious \& the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re\-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.
 


* Improver. Solver. Futurist.
* Great sense of humor.
* ‘Possible. It is.’ Mindset.
* Compassionate collaborator. Bold experimenter. Tireless iterator.
* Natural creativity that doesn’t just challenge the norm, but solves to design what’s better.
* Thinks in systems. Solves at scale.



  





**This Isn’t for Everyone.** 
 But if you’re the kind who questions
 *why* 
 things are done a certain way— and then identifies 3 better ways to do it — we’d love to chat with you.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 what you will wake up to solve.
 



  





 You are not just a Solutions Architect; you are a futurifier of our data universe and the primary enabler of our AI ambitions. With a deep\-seated passion for data engineering, you will architect and build the foundational data infrastructure that powers the customers entire data intelligence ecosystem.
 



 As the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for our enterprise\-grade data platforms, you own the outcome, end\-to\-end. You are the definitive solver for our customer's most complex data challenges, leveraging a powerful tech stack including Snowflake, Databricks, etc. and core GCP \& AWS services (BigQuery, Spanner, Airflow, Kafka). This is a hands\-on\-keys role where you won't just design solutions—you'll build them, break them, and perfect them.
 



  




* **Solution Design \& Pre\-sales Excellence:** 
 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and operations, to ensure successful project delivery.
* **Design Core Data Engineering:** 
 Master data modeling, architecting high\-performance data ingestion pipelines and ensuring data quality and governance throughout the data lifecycle.
* **Enable Cloud \& AI:** 
 Design and implement solutions utilizing core GCP data services, building foundational data platforms that efficiently support advanced analytics and AI/ML initiatives.
* **Optimize Performance \& Cost:** 
 Continuously optimize data architectures and implementations for performance, efficiency, and cost\-effectiveness within the cloud environment.
* **Bridge Business \& Tech:** 
 Translate complex business requirements into clear technical designs, providing technical leadership and guidance to data engineering teams.
* **Stay Ahead of the Curve:** 
 Continuously research and evaluate new data technologies, architectural patterns, and industry trends to keep our data platforms at the cutting edge.



  





**Welcome to Searce** 




*The ‘process\-first’, AI\-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.* 




**We don’t do traditional.** 




 As an engineering\-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving the real business outcomes. Our solvers co\-innovate with clients to
 **futurify** 
 operations and make processes smarter, faster \& better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.
 



 The result? Modern business reinvention, built on math, tech, and clarity of purpose.
 



  





**The DNA of a ‘Searcian’** 




*superpowers we value.* 




**The ‘happier’ core** 



* **happier\-at\-heart:** 
**h** 
 umble,
 **a** 
 daptable,
 **p**

 **p**

 **i**

 xcellence\-minded,

 Not just a poster on the wall; It's how we make decisions, treat each other, show up for clients \& hire or promote people.
* **Thinks like a founder. Acts like an owner.**
* **Always in Beta:** 
 Relentless curiosity. Openness to learn, un\-learn, and re\-learn.
* **Real Optimist:** 
 Views all setbacks as opportunities.
* **Believes in truth over comfort. Ideas over titles. Learning over knowing.**
* **Embraces chaos with calm. Evolves faster than the market.**



  





**Functional Skills:** 




  




* **Enterprise Data Architecture Design:** 
 Expert ability to design holistic, scalable, and resilient data architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* **Cloud Data Platform Strategy:** 
 Proven capability to strategize, design, and implement cloud\-native data platforms.
* **Pre\-Sales \& Technical Storyteller:** 
 Crafts compelling, client\-ready proposals, architectural decks, and technical demonstrations. Doesn't just present; shapes the strategic technical narrative behind every proposed solution.
* **Advanced Data Modelling:** 
 Mastery in designing various data models for analytical, operational, and transactional use cases.
* **Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Orchestration:** 
 Strong expertise in designing and optimizing robust data ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Exceptional skills in articulating complex technical concepts and architectural decisions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Performance \& Cost Optimization:** 
 Adept at optimizing data solutions for performance, efficiency, and cost within a cloud environment.



  





**Tech Superpowers:** 




  




* **Cloud Data Mastery:** 
 You're a wizard at leveraging public cloud data services, with deep expertise in GCP (BigQuery, Spanner, etc.) and expert proficiency in modern data warehouse solutions like Snowflake.
* **Data Engineering Core:** 
 Highly skilled in designing, implementing, and managing data workflows using tools like Apache Airflow and Apache Kafka. You're also an authority on advanced data modeling and ETL/ELT patterns.
* **AI/ML Data Foundation:** 
 You instinctively design data pipelines and structures that efficiently feed and empower Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
* **Programming for Data:** 
 You have a strong command over key programming languages (Python, SQL) for scripting, automation, and building data processing applications.

b3749615.title: Azure Data Architect
b3749615.description:
Azure Data Architect
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Azure Data Solutions Architect leads the design and implementation of enterprise\-scale data solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics. This role provides architectural leadership, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business strategy and industry best practices. The architect drives innovation, enforces governance, and mentors teams to deliver high\-quality, future\-ready data platforms that support organizational transformation.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Design and implement scalable data architectures using Azure services


Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Apache Spark


Architect data lake and data warehouse solutions using Azure Data Lake and Azure Synapse Analytics


Define data modeling strategies (batch \& real\-time processing)


Ensure data security, governance, and compliance standards


Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions


Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data workloads


Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows


Mentor and guide data engineers and development teams


Integrate advanced analytics, AI, and ML solutions when required


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Strong experience with Azure Databricks and Spark (PySpark/Scala)


Hands\-on experience with Azure services (ADF, ADLS, Synapse, Event Hub)


Expertise in big data architecture and distributed systems


Strong knowledge of SQL, Python, and data engineering concepts


Experience with data modeling techniques (star schema, dimensional modeling)


Understanding of real\-time streaming (Kafka/Event Hub)


Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices

  

Strong Development Area:


Data Engineering Foundations
  

Batch vs streaming; lakehouse concepts; medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold); file formats (Parquet/Delta/CSV/JSON/Avro); partitioning \& clustering; schema evolution; data governance basics; DevOps/CI\-CD for data.


SQL
  

Joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, set operations; aggregation \& rollups; MERGE/UPSERT; analytic functions; performance (indexes, partition pruning, statistics); data validation scenarios (dedupe, top\-N, SCD keys).


Apache Spark (Core)
  

Spark architecture (driver/executors), DAG, stages/tasks; RDD vs DataFrame/Dataset; wide vs narrow transformations; shuffle mechanics; caching/persistence; partitioning; broadcast joins; skew handling; checkpointing; job tuning.


PySpark
  

DataFrame API, Spark SQL; UDF vs pandas UDF; windowing; incremental loads; structured streaming (triggers, watermarks); handling semi\-structured data; optimizing with predicates, pushdown, join strategies; error handling; unit testing (pytest \+ chispa).


Databricks Platform
  

Workspace basics; clusters (Single Node/All\-Purpose/Jobs), cluster policies; DBR/LTS; notebooks \& Repos; Jobs \& Workflows; Delta Lake \& Delta Live Tables; Unity Catalog (catalog/schema/table, permissions, lineage); MLflow basics; secret scopes; DBFS; REST APIs; Databricks Connect.


Delta Lake / Lakehouse Patterns
  

ACID transactions; schema enforcement/evolution; time travel; OPTIMIZE/ZORDER; VACUUM; CDC patterns (MERGE INTO, change data feed); streaming vs batch Delta; expectations/constraints; table maintenance strategies.


Orchestration \& Scheduling
  

Databricks Workflows; Azure Data Factory/Synapse pipelines; triggers; parameter passing; fail/retry; alerts; integration with AutoSys/Control\-M/Jenkins/GitHub Actions; event\-driven patterns.


Python (Core for Data)
  

Core syntax; typing \& data structures; file I/O; logging; virtual environments; packaging; testing (pytest); common data libs (pandas, pyarrow); error handling; performance considerations (vectorization, generators).


Data Quality \& Testing
  

Great Expectations/dbx expectations or custom checks; unit/integration tests; reconciliation (row/amount); anomaly detection; contract testing for schemas; data observability (metrics, SLAs, freshness).


Security \& Governance
  

Unity Catalog permissions, row/column\-level security; secrets management (Key Vault/Secret scopes); PII handling; audit logs; token management; compliance basics.


Cost \& Performance Optimization
  

Cluster sizing, autoscaling; DBU awareness; spot/preemptible instances; storage formats; caching; efficient joins; job scheduling; monitoring with metrics \& Ganglia/Spark UI; cost tagging and chargeback.


Analytical Skills \& Problem Solving
  

Break down data problems; root\-cause incidents; propose alternatives; estimate complexity; communicate clearly with stakeholders.


Stake Holder Management
  

Interaction with Client Stakeholders, Communication.

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Recommended)
  

2\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (Optional But Valuable
