 Keeping up to date with the latest developments in the respective functional and technology area is key success criteria for this role.
   

  

 You appreciate the mix of strategic thinking and turning architecture trends and requirements into practice. You get motivated to keep learning and to forget the obsolete and to work agile and being open to the change. In addition, you are energized by working both independently and interdependently and cross functions. Last but not least you share and live the IKEA culture and values.
   

  

 For this role we believe you have, solid SAP S/4 Finance experience. Experience of the R2R – Record to Report process is critical to the role. Experience of delivering multi country implementations of SAP products and SAP S4/HANA platform as a solution architect. Have exposure to technologies beyond SAP and not be limited by platform in devising the technology stack strategy. Have strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to convince the leadership in Finance organization, country Leadership and Enterprise architects.
   

  

 Acts as a positive force to bring out the best in people. Must lead by example in line with IKEA values and leadership compass. Is a strategic thinker with strong foundations \& proficiency in content in either or both functional or technology area, proven delivery capabilities in leading in the SAP technology/platform.
   

  

 You have experience in the following areas:
   

  

 20\+ years of experience in building Finance technology roadmap and solutions with relevant experience in providing the same in Retail Domain
   

 Proven experience in evangelizing organizations with outside in technology knowledge which is practical and relevant to the business processes and the tactical and strategic objectives of the business
   

 Proven experience in working with business stakeholders and advising/influencing business strategy roadmap by leveraging knowledge in the relevant insights and developments in technology capabilities
   

 Deep knowledge of the changing landscape and new products impacting finance processes
   

 Experience in drafting 3\-year and 5\-year roadmaps for digital organizations in the relevant technology area in SAP Finance. Knowledge of other ERP capabilities is an added advantage.
   

 Building strong relationships with stakeholders
   

 Track record of delivering successful projects, managing and maintaining the integrity of established SAP templates, navigating complex situations, influencing senior stakeholders with the relevant information, insights.
   

 Strong communication skills, verbal, written and presentation.
   

 Demonstrable critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
   

 Good knowledge of SAP platform architecture/engineering across multiple modules and technology domains
   

 Strong understanding of processes, application of the same and trends in SAP technology/platforms
   

 Experience in building business case for multi\-year programs and getting consensus from CXO organization.
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 A solution architect is a key leadership role who has deep expertise in the business processes and their solution implementation in the respective functional area. A Solution Architect must have strong leadership capabilities, balance functional and technical acumen with effective
   

  

 communication, strategic thinking, and adaptability to steer the relevant optimal solution implementations as well as safeguard the sanctity of the design.
   

  

 This role involves continuous learning and evolution to keep up with the ever\-changing technology landscape and business needs.
   

  

 Your responsibilities are:
   

  

 Summary
   

 Understand/Analyses the Technology and Business Process landscape to develop relevant insights. Leverages deep expertise in the respective Functional/Technology area to develop, steer optimal solutions that are holistic and scalable, that simplify the technology landscape and enable agility in enabling/unlocking business value and potentially pivot the business case positively.
   

 Uses strong leadership capabilities combined with effective communication to build strong network and relationships within the business and technology stakeholders.
   

 Is passionate about keeping up to date with current developments and industry best practices in the relevant functional and technology area.
   

 Exhibits strong accountability/ownership, is proactive, is resourceful and able to navigate and influence/pivot discussions, using logic, expertise, insights and data.
   

  

 Technical/Functional Expertise:
   

 Possess a deep understanding of business processes in the retail industry and their implementation in the relevant technology platform, functional modules, coupled with strong leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, business process analysis and optimization, stakeholder management, and complex ecosystem familiarity.
   

 Understand and analyze the technology, functional and business process landscape, interfaces.
   

 Work with business process owners, technology architects to design \& architect simple, scalable and effective solutions considering integration, data flows, and functional modules which will help secure a strong solution foundation in the relevant technology/area.
   

 Works with Functional teams to analyze requirements, cross functional, cross solution and cross domain impact. Ensures conceptual designs/blueprints are holistic and effectively documented.
   

 Own product backlog and prioritize the releases along with process owners.
   

 Co\-leads \& participates in workshops for clarifying requirements and arriving at confirmed scope. Participates in the relevant cross functional/domain meetings for analyzing and communicating impact
   

 Provides inputs and builds solutions that could positively pivot business case.
   

 Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the project lifecycle. Collaborates with development and project/program teams to design and implement enhancements, and interfaces, ensuring compliance with best practices and standards.
   

 Participates in Release management gates and provides go/no\-go from solution perspective (scalability, performance, invasiveness, integration, design, etc.). Ensure that the solution complies with industry\-specific regulations and organizational compliance policies.
   

  

 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management:
   

 Brings strong collaborations across the organization, builds a strong network and relationships within the business and technology stakeholders, is able to navigate within and across organization.
   

 Staying up to date with the latest technologies, trends, and industry best. You will continuously evaluate and incorporate new methodologies, tools, and frameworks to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the technology/platform. Builds effective partnerships with Suppliers for gaining insights, leveraging and improving solution direction.
   

 Exhibits strong accountability/ownership, rigor and a “can do” mindset.
   

 Builds and communicates solution vision effectively, drives clarity while simplifying the objectives, is proactive, is resourceful and Influences/pivots discussions, using logic, expertise, insights and data.
   

 Positively influences the team.
   

  

 Supplier:
   

 Works with industry partners and suppliers and technology architects to continuously investigate and bring in best of breed solutions to improve and develop a future\-enabled solution landscape.
   

 Is passionate about keeping up to date with current developments and industry best practices in the relevant functional and technology area and leverages connects with suppliers towards this objective
   

  

 Problem\-Solving and Decision\-Making:
   

 Analyzing complex issues and identifying creative and effective solutions, leveraging and weighing existing solutions, a holistic perspective of the problem statements and solutions and where appropriate build/reuse existing solutions \& capabilities
   

 Making well\-informed decisions based on data, insights, and stakeholder input.
   

 Handling crises and high\-pressure situations with composure and sound judgment. Encouraging a culture of problem\-solving and innovation within the team.
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

faa6527a.title: Solutions Architect (Managed Services)
faa6527a.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect (Managed Services) based in India.**
 This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role focused on designing, operating, and evolving large\-scale modern data platforms. You’ll lead complex cloud and data infrastructure initiatives across Snowflake, AWS, Azure, and related data ecosystem technologies. The role combines solution architecture, production support, technical leadership, client engagement, and continuous platform improvement. You’ll guide engineering teams while managing multiple customer environments and technology stacks simultaneously. Your work will directly influence platform performance, security, scalability, automation, and user satisfaction. The position is well suited to an experienced architect who enjoys solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and operating in a fast\-paced managed services environment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design, propose, and provision cloud\-native data solutions across AWS and Azure, leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, IAM, S3, EC2, Kinesis, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, Azure Data Factory, ADLS, Fivetran, dbt, and related services.
* Lead technical teams responsible for operating and managing modern data platforms spanning streaming, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics, and evolving technology stacks.
* Own the technical relationship and delivery across multiple customer accounts, providing architectural direction across varied environments and technology platforms.
* Assess complex customer environments and translate improvement opportunities into actionable Epics, Stories, and Tasks that mature and optimize data platforms.
* Delegate work to engineers, provide coaching and mentorship, and ensure technical initiatives are delivered successfully and on schedule.
* Provide architectural thought leadership and recommend technologies and approaches that improve performance, security, scalability, reliability, and overall user satisfaction.
* Lead and contribute to data architecture discussions, including data model design for data warehouses and data lakes.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and apply performance tuning techniques across cloud, data, and distributed systems.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational activities, optimize platform performance, and expand managed data services.
* Create and deliver detailed technical presentations and recommendations for executive\-level audiences.
* Continuously improve processes, procedures, and operational practices across customer environments and internal delivery teams.


**Requirements**
* Extensive experience supporting enterprise data platforms in production, including technologies such as Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Databricks.
* Significant architectural guidance and operational support experience for large user bases and cloud\-native data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift, with a background in Systems Engineering, DevOps, DBA, or Data Architecture.
* Production experience with cloud and distributed storage technologies such as Amazon S3, ADLS, HDFS, Elasticsearch/Solr, Cassandra, or other NoSQL platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration technologies such as Spark, Kafka, event streaming, Fivetran, HVR, NiFi, AWS Data Migration Service, Azure Data Factory, or comparable tools.
* Experience with workflow management and orchestration technologies such as Airflow, AWS Managed Airflow, Luigi, or NiFi.
* Strong SQL expertise, including the ability to write, debug, and optimize complex queries.
* Deep working knowledge of cloud\-native data technologies within AWS or Azure.
* Demonstrated ability to create, challenge, and improve technical processes and operational procedures.
* Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and performance\-tuning capabilities.
* Proven experience leading and mentoring engineers and supporting technical teams through continuous learning and upskilling.
* Strong interest in learning new technology stacks and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technical environments.
* Excellent client\-facing written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
* Strong presentation skills and confidence communicating technical recommendations to executive audiences.
* Strong business awareness, problem\-solving ability, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple customer priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical teams, customer organizations, and different technology platforms.
* Preferred experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Preferred hands\-on Python experience for building automation and eliminating repetitive support tasks.
* Familiarity with CI/CD frameworks and tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub, Flyway, and Liquibase is advantageous.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core certification is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline is preferred.


**Benefits**
* Remote work opportunity based in India.
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and their families.
* Medical insurance coverage for parents.
* Term life insurance and personal accident coverage.
* Wellness allowance.
* Broadband reimbursement.
* Professional development allowance.
* Reimbursement for skill\-upgrade and professional certifications.
* Opportunity to work on large\-scale cloud and data platform environments.
* Exposure to Snowflake, AWS, Azure, modern data integration, orchestration, automation, and analytics technologies.
* Senior\-level ownership across multiple customer environments and technical stacks.
* Opportunities to lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams.
* Fast\-paced environment with complex technical challenges and continuous opportunities to learn and expand expertise.

 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.  hands\-on experience implementing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Warehouse
   

  

 Management Cloud solutions. The role will translate warehouse requirements into
   

  

 practical solution designs, configure core WMS processes, support integrations,

 business and technical stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine strong

 Key Responsibilities

 processes.

 systems, transportation platforms, automation equipment, and third\-party

 support.

171b1a56.title: Client Delivery Manager
171b1a56.description:
**Objective:** 




  





 As a Client Delivery Manager, you support the company's objectives by ensuring corporate interests are safeguarded before the customer contract is signed (feasibility and implementation options) as well as organizing the implementation after the contractual agreement with the customer has been concluded. The implementation specifically relates to the contractually owed services, typically for qualified customer solutions that cannot be fulfilled through a standardized delivery process but require project coordination over various delivery units for planning (pre\-sales phase) and during the actual delivery. Client Delivery Management is responsible for the planning, execution, acceptance, and follow\-up of qualified, non\-standardized delivery projects.
 



  





**Main Tasks:** 




  




* Coordination of contractual requirements and the services and deliveries to be provided with customer management and the departments
* Planning and implementation of customer projects involving all necessary stakeholders and coordination of interfaces
* Monitoring deadlines, milestones, dependencies, and risks\- General project reporting and timely escalation to management
* Tracking of risks and development of measures for risk mitigation
* Planning and conducting cross\-disciplinary coordination, quality gates workshops, and supporting project participants to achieve project goals\- Assistance in project planning (definition and coordination of project goals, resource/time/effort budgeting, planning of work packages)
* Definition of project workflow and project process organizations, planning and conducting the project kickoff with the involved departments
* Operational support in (sub\-)projects by performing PM tasks (e.g. moderation of workshops)
* Continuous development of project methodology within the team and optimization of processes and tools for comprehensive project management.



  





**Professional Skills required:** 




  




* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in business administration, engineering, computer science, or comparable professional experience
* Demonstrated experience in successful delivery of managed services to clients, meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards, with contractual agreements and compliance requirements as well as monitoring contract performance
* Knowledge of power supply and cooling of data centers, Cx ing, Fit\-Out, Security, Connectivity infrastructure, as well as product knowledge (racks, networking, data center and IT\-related services, etc.)
* Experience and certification in common project management methods such as Prince2, Scrum are desirable
* At least 5\-9 years of relevant professional experience and proven successes in project management in (national and international) data center environments

5679c55d.title: ServiceNow Solution Architect (FSM, ITSM & CMDB)
5679c55d.description:
**Role Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with deep expertise in Field Service Management (FSM), IT Service Management (ITSM), CMDB, and enterprise integrations. * Create intuitive user experiences using ServiceNow UI Builder and Service Portal, including wireframes and mockups.
* Design and oversee integrations with enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration platforms.

* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

* Work on enterprise\-scale digital transformation initiatives using the ServiceNow platform.
* Design innovative and scalable solutions for global customers across multiple industries.
* Collaborate with experienced architects, consultants, and technology leaders.
* Gain exposure to complex integrations, platform modernization, and next\-generation ServiceNow capabilities.
* Enjoy continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and career growth in a collaborative environment.
* Make a significant impact by delivering business\-critical solutions that drive operational excellence.



  





**We would like you to bring along** 



* 10\+ years of overall IT experience with strong expertise in ServiceNow solution architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow FSM, ITSM, and CMDB implementations.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, and best practices.
* Experience with UI Builder, Service Portal, and user experience design.
* Expertise in designing and implementing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and IntegrationHub.
* Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and architectural discussions.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow upgrades, instance management, governance, and platform optimization.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Good\-to\-have skills** 



* Experience with Dell Boomi or other enterprise integration platforms.
* Exposure to ServiceNow Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Automation Engine.
* Knowledge of CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA (Certified System Administrator), CAD (Certified Application Developer), and CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist).

bcc0133a.title: Technical Program Manager
bcc0133a.description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Summary:
   

  

 The Risk and Security team (RAS) is a key component of the Value\-Added Services (VAS) PD division within Visa. VAS\-RAS has a suite of high visibility, high\-volume, revenue earning applications that provide solutions related to Risk Management, Identity and Authentication. Our capabilities are used extensively by key players in the payment eco\-space across the globe.
   

  

 Our Technical Program Managers are highly visible leaders, building bridges across Visa to ensure projects are effectively developed, integrated and deployed with quality and on time delivery into our production systems.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager for our RAS team, you will drive quality and velocity of our technology. You should be comfortable with owning issues and managing the outcome. You enjoy driving, resolving, facilitating and follow up. You understand the risks and the trade\-offs and are both technical and process focused.
   

  

 A strong candidate will have a solid experience with technology/product program management, agentic development, release management, x\-functional team leadership, as well as superb skills in communications, business analysis, problem\-solving, cross\-team coordination, communications, processes, and change management. The ideal candidate is not just a facilitator or project plan tracker but is self motivated and ensures things get done. The ideal candidate must have a drive to get things done and a “make it happen” attitude.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Key resource to lead/support end\-to\-end planning and execution of one or more projects and/or Agile/Kanban teams that are part of a larger program. Contribute to and facilitate negotiations on scope, schedule, budget, risks, releases and communications.
* Coach multiple teams through the software development life cycle using Agentic Development, Kanban, Agile, Scrum, and Lean practices and work cross\-functionally throughout the company to ensure projects are developed and deployed with quality and timely delivery into our production systems.
* Ask thoughtful questions to help our customers, product owners, and product managers to maximize ROI and meet company objectives. Understand product strategy and benefits of key deliverables in area of responsibility.
* Work with product owners to promote and contribute to the improvement of the product backlog
* Drive planning, dependency and risk management, architecture completion, backlog grooming, reviews/demos, retrospectives, and other key ceremonies related to both Kanban and Scrum in an agentic environment
* Facilitate discussion and conflict resolution
* Coach team in estimation techniques
* Shield the team from outside distractions and interferences
* Track and remove impediments for the team
* Develop metrics and reports using JA/Jira/GIT/Claude to help the team understand its health and progress and to set goals
* Lead team in its Agentic Development adoption
* Lead Agentic Development release planning
* Ensure clear communication and collaboration among the Product Owner and members of the Development team
* Ensure the program and projects are in compliance with Visa's Project Management Methodology and Key Controls and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status.
* Provide timely and accurate reporting to all stakeholders; hold regular cross organizational management briefings.
* Lead boldly and utilize hard and soft skills to influence participants of all levels towards the common goal.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks and issues.
* Identify and manage dependencies and impacts
* Drive improvement in overall efficiency and reliability of our release and deployment processes.
* Facilitate solutions for identified security vulnerabilities and track to timely remediation
* Exercise independent judgment with minimal direction from supervisor.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or other technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (BS) in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree is a plus.
* 7\+ years of experience, as an Analyst, Technical Project/Program Manager or Developer, working with technical teams developing Enterprise class software applications.
* Ability to work with global teams and ability to lead and influence across all time zones
* Hands on experience with Claude/GIT/Jira/JA
* Excellent analytical skills and enthusiastic problem solver
* Strong leadership qualities and organizational skills as well as the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, assignments, and roles.
* Strong knowledge of Project Management, ADLC, SDLC principles and practices and agile frameworks.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. A demonstrated ability to effectively document and communicate technical and business issues and solutions to appropriate organizational levels.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance. Ability to prioritize work, multi\-task and manage one’s time.
* Ability to thoroughly understand complex business and technical issues and influence decision making at all levels of the organization without formal reporting structure authority.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

13c4b9e9.title: Senior Solutions Specialist - Presales
13c4b9e9.description:
**Role Purpose\-**
 To support business development efforts by guiding and overseeing the demonstration and delivery of Nucleus’ platforms \& solutions as a part of client sales pitches and provide support in client management at the demo stage.
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility\-**
**Product Demonstration\-**
* Participate in sales strategy meetings and offer inputs based on market/competitor information and internal analysis.
* Ensure that support is provided to sales teams during pitches through product demonstrations and presentations that best highlight the product’s features, utility and competitive advantage to potential clients.
* Engage, question, and participate in deep\-dive discussions/ value workshops with customers and/or Sales team for thorough understanding of customers' existing scenarios, business drivers, pain\-points, gaps, competition, core objectives; seek clarity on and understand customers' evaluation processes \& key evaluation criteria.
* Lead and conduct clients demos or workshops for large account pitches and offer inputs based on client requirements and product features.
* Act as a product evangelist and highlight benefits of product features to clients as well as internal teams.
* Conduct GA Sanity Testing after GA release deployed in Pre\-Sales servers.


**RFPs\-**
* Thoroughly review the RFP document to understand the client's requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission guidelines.
* Identify key stakeholders and subject matter experts needed for the response.
* Collaborate with technical experts to design a solution that meets the client's needs.
* Ensure the proposed solution aligns with the company's capabilities and strategic goals.
* Draft responses for each section of the RFP, including functional aspects and Executive Summary.
* Use existing content libraries and past proposals to streamline the writing process.
* Ensure that all responses comply with the RFP requirements and guidelines.
* Verify that all mandatory information and documents are included.
* Conduct internal reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Edit the content to improve readability and impact.
* Identify potential risks associated with the proposed solution and develop mitigation strategies.
* Document any assumptions and dependencies.
* Perform a final review of the entire RFP response to ensure completeness and quality.
* Prepare for potential presentations, demos or discussions with the client post\-submission.


**Relationship Building\-**
* Liaise with client stakeholders and ensure all requirements are gathered in order to structure the product demos and other supporting collaterals
* Engage with prospective clients and industry leaders to understand business challenges and incorporate changes in internal procedures


**Process Improvement\-**
* Stay up to date with industry leading best practices and latest trends and offer insights to sales teams as well as product development teams.
* Implement new processes and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of product demonstrations.


**People Management\-**
* Review MIS reports created by Pre\-sales Executives; analyze and provide insights to senior stakeholders as required.
* Manage, mentor and inspire a team and team members including managing performance, goals and development potential, and evaluate potential new talent.
* Provide support to resolve conflict between multiple work streams / groups; provide inputs on goal setting and performance appraisals of team members; identify training needs for associates based on the client requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across the team; provide support to team members to achieve their knowledge goals and build expertise.


**Requirements**
* Detailed Knowledge of Products and Solutions.
* Good understanding of the target domain/industry.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-centric approach.
* Proven networking and relationship\-building skills to establish and maintain strong connections with customers, partners, and internal teams


**Benefits**
 Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is a cloud\-based HR Technology platform which caters to an organization’s HR needs across the employee lifecycle including Recruitment, Onboarding, Core transactions (Leaves, Attendance, Directory), Payroll, Travel and Expenses, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Rewards \& Recognition and People Analytics. The modern and innovative platform combines highly configurable workflows, intelligent insights and smart interfaces to help enterprises unleash the true potential of their workforce. Darwinbox is trusted by 650\+ global enterprises with more than 1\.5 million employees spread across 90\+ countries including Asia’s largest conglomerates and fast\-growing unicorns like Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, JSW, NSE, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Bharti AXA, Nivea, T\-Systems, Swiggy, BigBasket, Delhivery and more. It is backed by leading investors like TCV, Salesforce Ventures, Sequoia, Lightspeed, Endiya Partners, 3One4Capital, SCB 10X and JGDEV.
   

  

 More at www.darwinbox.com
   

  

**About the team:** 
 As a member of our diverse and skilled global solutioning team you will have the opportunity to don multiple hats and be challenged daily. This team is focused on enabling end\-to\-end HR digital transformation for our customers and is dedicated to working with customers to align their digital vision with their business strategy and supporting the plan to get there. On a typical day, you will be working as part of an agile team responsible for conducting discovery calls and product solutioning to help prospective clients transform and streamline their business to their fullest potential, using market data and strategic judgment to stay in front of our competitors. The HCM Solution Manager are responsible for partnering with the sales teams and deliver the Darwinbox value proposition to business users including the offices of the CHRO, CIO, and CFO. They play a critical role in the success of every sales pursuit we make. By leveraging deep HR functional expertise and comprehensive product knowledge the Solutions Consultant provides expert solutions through presentations, workshops, and product demonstrations to the customer throughout the sales cycle.
   

  

**What’s Expected of You:**
* Participate in discovery workshops with users to formulate and document business requirements, including business processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Assist in the development of winning and differentiating value propositions and themes/messaging to customers, in collaboration with the sales team.
* Develop and champion Darwinbox value\-based solutions to client problems, communicate them with the customer, implementation partners and internal stakeholders. This may involve various formats/viewpoints, such as process flows, context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions and recordings and functional demonstrations.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and develop solution overviews that map customer’s business initiatives to the Darwinbox HCM solution.
* Prepare for and conduct winning demonstrations of the Darwinbox HCM solution to create impact in customer evaluation processes, while demonstrating the value proposition and customer expectations.
* Build expertise in specific industries and presenting the value of Darwinbox HCM solution to customers in those industries.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationship with key customer stakeholders who are influencers and decision\-makers in an evaluation process.
* Research and highlight the advantages of Darwinbox HCM and capability over legacy ERP and other SaaS systems.
* Continuously upgrade your skillsets and knowledge through the learning opportunities provided by Darwinbox.


**Who Should Apply?**
* 8yrs of experience in HCM Consulting / HRBP role.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant work experience
* Value\-based selling in an HCM Consulting environment
* Proven ability to work and effectively communicate with C\-level executives and line of business representatives.
* Proven ability to understand client pain points and proposing solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

a40f51c8.title: Solution Consultant
a40f51c8.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 Solution Consultant
   

  

 Mumbai
   

  

 You will support sales at main customer pursuits by providing specific solution expertise in a defined geographical area. The Solution Consultant is the solution expert for the sales organisation by assisting with delivering outcome\-based messaging to customers at executive and management levels. The Solution Consultant has a broad understanding of all related products and delivery offerings from RA, partners and competitors in the designated solution area.
   

  

 You will report to the Consultant Leader and work onsite in Mumbai, India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Be the focal point in the defined geography for the solution(s), of which you have been designated as an expert.
* Participate in account planning and sales strategy focusing on new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion.
* Facilitate and provide training to the sales team on the values and outcomes of specific solution(s).
* Co\-operate with the sales team in promoting the solution to all customers with presentations and demonstrations.
* Advise Technology Consultants and sales on proposal generation and validation.
* Assist sales at proposal presentations for executive level customers
* Define and articulate differentiators and values versus competition for the solution. Analyse products, have knowledge of competitor's strategy, further define competitive differentiators.
* Translate competitive solutions into a RA solution that meets customer's expectations.
* Seek out and participate in training opportunities to develop technical skills.
* Provide product gap and development feedback for the solution to appropriate organisations.
* Share insights with peers.
* Focus on opportunities that support Rockwell Automation's strategy.
* Understand business models, organisation, and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Knowledge of industry strategies, familiarity with outcome\-based selling.
* Share industry knowledge of customers based on their important causes at the appropriate role level with all customers
* Keep sales and customer relationship management data up to date in local agreed upon tools such as SFA, optimising by using these tools.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering/technical related field or equivalent experience.
* Value of larger Rockwell Automation application value, without the need to demonstrate individual products with hands\-on demonstrations
* Solution and application expertise, and related demonstrated sales experience.
* Fluency in native language and command of English (written and spoken).
* Work with and gain confidence of senior level personnel (internal and external) in a collaborative, matrixed organisation.
* Align and influence critical stakeholders.
* Support customer centricity. Understand the importance of demonstrating concern for satisfying customers. Passionate about developing goals to improve our customer experience.
* Set, be accountable for and achieve challenging targets.
* empower, coach and motivate others.
* Communication style and messaging to different audiences.


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* Proficiency in hands\-on engineering
* High level of expertise in Continuous and Batch Process Control which shall include knowledge of multiple ISA standards, practical experience designing and deploying control and electrical systems and solutions, High level of Application Knowledge.
* Practical knowledge of process unit operations and typical automation requirements of such process units
* Experience of the Process industry goals.
* Intermediate level of expertise in MES/Information Solutions, Networks and Services and Solutions, with a basic understanding of automation and electrical devices.
* Intermediate level of Industry Knowledge and Selling Skills.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

**About The Team**
 The Cloud \& Infrastructure Solutions team at Redington enables customers to modernize, automate, and scale their IT environments using leading cloud and DevOps technologies. The team collaborates closely with customers, business stakeholders, architects, developers, operations teams, and OEM partners to design, implement, and optimize cloud\-native solutions that drive agility, security, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Purpose of the Job**
 To design, implement, automate, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure and DevOps platforms while enabling customers to accelerate digital transformation. The role focuses on cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, CI/CD automation, security, and operational excellence to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available AWS\-based solutions.
   

  

**Who We're Looking For**
 We are looking for a highly skilled and customer\-focused AWS \& DevOps Engineer with 3\-8 years of experience in AWS cloud technologies, DevOps automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Kubernetes platforms.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate Should Possess**
* Strong expertise in AWS cloud services and cloud architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Strong working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, and AWS Fargate.
* Experience automating infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows.
* Good scripting knowledge using Python.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with customers, development, operations, security, and business teams.


**Your Role**
**AWS Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, deploy, and manage AWS cloud environments.
* Build scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures.
* Manage and administer AWS services including:
+ EC2
+ VPC
+ IAM
+ S3
+ RDS
+ ECS/EKS
+ Lambda
+ CloudFront
+ Route 53
+ CloudWatch

* Optimize cloud environments for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives.


**DevOps \& Automation**
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment processes.
* Support release management and deployment automation.
* Integrate testing, security scanning, and compliance controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement GitOps and DevSecOps best practices.
* Improve deployment reliability and operational efficiency through automation.


**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
* Develop and manage cloud infrastructure using:
+ Terraform
+ AWS CloudFormation
+ AWS CDK

* Create reusable infrastructure modules and templates.
* Maintain version\-controlled infrastructure repositories.
* Standardize and automate cloud provisioning processes.


**Containerization \& Kubernetes**
* Containerize applications using Docker.
* Deploy and manage workloads on:
+ Amazon ECS
+ AWS Fargate
+ Amazon EKS

* Configure and manage Kubernetes clusters and deployments.
* Optimize container orchestration, availability, and scalability.
* Support cloud\-native application deployments and modernization initiatives.


**Monitoring \& Operations**
* Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
* Configure alerts, dashboards, and incident response mechanisms.
* Work with tools such as:
+ Amazon CloudWatch
+ Grafana
+ Prometheus
+ ELK/OpenSearch

* Troubleshoot infrastructure, application, and performance issues.
* Ensure platform reliability and operational excellence.


**Security \& Compliance**
* Implement AWS security best practices.
* Manage IAM roles, policies, permissions, and access controls.
* Automate vulnerability assessments and compliance checks.
* Support security audits and governance initiatives.
* Ensure cloud environments adhere to security and regulatory standards.


**You’re the Right Fit If You**
* Have strong expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices.
* Possess hands\-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Can build and manage enterprise\-grade CI/CD pipelines.
* Have experience administering Kubernetes and container platforms.
* Are proficient in scripting and automation using Python.
* Understand security, governance, and compliance best practices in cloud environments.
* Can collaborate effectively with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* Have a passion for cloud\-native technologies, automation, and continuous improvement.


**Core Competencies**
* AWS Cloud Architecture
* AWS Infrastructure Management
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK)
* CI/CD Pipeline Automation
* Jenkins \& GitHub Actions
* Docker \& Containerization
* Kubernetes Administration
* Amazon ECS, EKS \& Fargate
* DevOps \& DevSecOps Practices
* Cloud Security \& Governance
* Monitoring \& Observability
* Python Scripting \& Automation
* Cloud Cost Optimization
* Troubleshooting \& Performance Tuning
* Solution Design \& Modernization

* Customer Centricity
* Strong Communication Skills
* Analytical Thinking

* Ownership \& Accountability
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility
* Stakeholder Management

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)

aee11b5a.title: Capital Program Manager
aee11b5a.description:
Technical Capital Program Manager – Data Centre\& Lab Facilities
  
**LOCATION:** CessnaBangalore, India
  
**AREA OF INTEREST:** Construction Program Management
  
**TECHNOLOGY INTEREST:** Data Centres, Laboratories\& Critical Facilities
  
  

About the Role
  
  

Workplace Resources (WPR) is seeking a Technical Capital Program Manager to lead the delivery of capital projects with a specific focus on data centre and laboratory environments across the APJC (Asia Pacific, Japan\& China) region. This role combines the core discipline of capital program management \- planning, budgeting, and delivering projects from inception through handover \- with the technical depth required to manage complex, mission\-critical facilities where uptime, resiliency, and compliance are paramount.
  
The ideal candidate will bring a strong construction/capital program management background together with hands\-on exposure to data centre or lab build, fit\-out, or upgrade projects, and will be comfortable engaging directly with M engineers, critical facilities teams, and specialist technical vendors.
  
The candidate should be based close to our Bangalore campus and have the ability to be on campus, participate in meetings in person and interact with vendors as needed.
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

Workplace Resources (WPR) delivers workplace experiences to employees and optimizes company working capital at scale, with a focus on productivity and business outcomes. Within WPR, the Workplace Design\& Construction Team comprises four pillars: Design, Change Management, Centralized Capital Program Management, and Commercial Management Offices. The team is responsible for the delivery of projects including data centre, lab, and critical facilities work, in addition to a broader transformational effort shaping how employees, partners, and customers interact with company spaces for decades to come.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As Technical Capital Program Manager, you will be accountable for planning, executing, and finalizing capital projects, including data centre and laboratory builds and upgrades, according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes partnering with global procurement to acquire resources, coordinating the efforts of internal team members and third\-party contractors or consultants, and acting as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.
  
  

What You'll Do Day\-to\-Day
  
  

* Manage APJC capital program service partners to successfully plan, design, deliver, handover of capital projects assigned to you.
* Own the successful planning, brief development, and budgeting of a portfolio of capital projects, determined by the manager, with particular emphasis on technical and critical\-infrastructure spaces.
* Act as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.
* Effectively manage both upward communication to clients and stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment, while providing clear, actionable direction and feedback to team members through consistent downward communication.
* Develop Project Execution Plans and manage Change Control for technical builds, including data centre and lab\-specific commissioning and validation stages.
* Ensure projects comply with Construction Health\& Safety Guidelines as well as data centre and laboratory\-specific safety, security, and compliance standards.
* Develop a quarterly APJC Delivery Plan identifying requirements for capital projects, including due diligence, due diligence funding, and partner resourcing.
* Own due diligence for capital projects managed by service partners, ensuring cross\-functional input (risk management, IT, critical facilities engineering, capital project management).
* Own compliance to global offerings guidelines and standards, including relevant data centre design and operational standards.
* Solve complex problems and identify viable, innovative options, using analytical skills and judgment to recommend an appropriate solution, particularly where technical, operational, and construction constraints intersect.
* Translate strategy into clear operating plans that promote operational excellence in service delivery with measurable results.
* Leverage program management expertise, together with technical facilities knowledge, to identify areas of risk or concern in complex, mission\-critical builds.


Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Capital Project Planning: Using agreed business requirements from WPR partners, develop comprehensive project plans, including for data centre and lab environments, that align with the strategic objectives of the organization.
* Technical\& Critical Facilities Delivery: Partner with project teams, M engineers, critical facilities operations, and specialist vendors to deliver data centre and laboratory capital projects, covering power, cooling, redundancy, and life\-safety systems.
* Portfolio Management: Oversee the performance of multiple projects, ensuring they remain on track in terms of scope, schedule, and budget.
* Budget Management: Partner with the Commercial Management Office to oversee budget development and financial project controls; partner with business managers on budget submissions to the Capital Finance Review Board.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholder engagement across the APJC Theatre for assigned programme, providing updates on project performance and addressing concerns.
* Team Coordination: Lead, coach, and motivate project team members and project managers leading and executing projects in your portfolio, influencing them to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work.
* Risk Management: Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path, assess risks, including those specific to live or occupied technical environments and develop mitigation strategies.
* Reporting: Track project milestones and deliverables and prepare status reports for senior management.
* Performance Monitoring: Track and report on project metrics and performance indicators to senior management.
* Process Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes and methodologies, including those specific to data centre and lab delivery, to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.


Knowledge, Skills\& Experience
  
  

* Deep understanding of the processes, procedures, and systems used in Capital Program Management and Service Delivery Management, and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines.
* Working technical knowledge of data centre and/or laboratory environments, including power and cooling infrastructure, redundancy/resiliency concepts, and commissioning processes.
* Proficient with technology, tools, and processes that support service delivery; plays a part in promoting and developing improvements to functional tools and processes.
* Deep knowledge of project/program management methodologies and an understanding of real estate and critical facilities industry practices, evolution, and application to service delivery processes.
* Ability to analyse multiple sources of complex information and evaluate several alternative solutions before recommending a path forward.
* Ability to explain complex technical information and effectively lay out the pros and cons of alternatives for non\-technical stakeholders to consider.
* Strongly developed ability to communicate and drive improvement across cross\-functional teams to improve operations metrics and customer satisfaction; strong service level management and operations management skills.
* Deep understanding of key Capital Program Management concepts with the ability to explain these effectively to management or cross\-functional teams and provide training.


Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in project and program management (8\+ years minimum), with a strong focus on construction capital program management and program delivery for construction projects.
* Demonstrable experience delivering data centre, laboratory, or other mission\-critical/technical facility projects, from design through commissioning and handover.
* Expertise in managing diverse teams of vendors, M engineers, and contractors across multiple projects.
* Demonstrates proficiency in concise reporting and clear communication when providing updates to senior leadership.
* Proficiency in project management software tools.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Knowledge of local regulations and industry standards relevant to data centre and laboratory construction across APJC markets, specifically Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Bangalore, India.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience managing projects in sectors such as data centres, laboratories, critical infrastructure, or IT/technology fit\-out.
* Certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is a plus.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

b82be192.title: Senior Delivery Manager / Delivery Lead
b82be192.description:
We are looking for a delivery leader to own the end\-to\-end execution of our AI \& Data engagements for large enterprise clients — Fortune 500 and Fortune 100 organisations across industries. These are high\-stakes transformation programs where the work spans agentic AI, generative AI, and modern data platforms.
 



 The role flexes by program shape. At peak, you may run a single large, multi\-POD program with a sizeable embedded team. At other times you will run a portfolio of two to three smaller engagements in parallel, typically five to eight people each. We expect you to be equally comfortable orchestrating a large team through governance and cadence, and staying hands\-on across several smaller teams without dropping a thread.
 



 You are accountable for delivering to plan, keeping teams efficient and well\-utilised, protecting delivery quality, and sustaining client confidence on programs that are watched closely by senior enterprise stakeholders.
 



**What makes this role different:** 
 these are agentic and GenAI builds, not deterministic IT projects. “Done” is defined by evaluations, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation rather than a fixed spec. We need a delivery leader who understands that reality in their bones — who can plan around non\-determinism, set honest expectations with clients, and recognise the difference between what is genuinely production\-ready and what is still aspirational.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




**Delivery execution \& governance** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of one large program or 2–3 parallel engagements against committed scope, timeline, and quality.
* Run the delivery rhythm: planning, sprint cadence, status reporting, risk and dependency management, and escalation discipline.
* Keep delivery on plan; flag scope creep, slippage, and risk early and credibly.



**Agentic \& GenAI delivery leadership** 



* Lead delivery of agentic and GenAI solutions, applying the right rigour to non\-deterministic systems — evaluations, guardrails, model/version drift, and human\-in\-the\-loop gating.
* Set realistic, honest expectations with clients on what agentic systems can and cannot do today.
* Partner with the AI Labs and POD teams to move solutions from pilot to production reliably.



**Team \& POD leadership** 



* Lead and coach POD leads, Forward Deployed Engineers, and engineering teams; set standards and unblock the team.
* Manage staffing, ramp\-up, and clean resource movement across engagements as priorities shift.
* Be the most senior delivery presence in the room — technically credible enough that the team respects your judgement.



**Client \& stakeholder management** 



* Be the trusted delivery point of contact for senior client stakeholders, including CIO\-, VP\-, and director\-level.
* Translate between client objectives and technical reality; protect the relationship while holding firm on scope and quality.
* Navigate a multi\-vendor environment and keep the engagement positioned as a confident, neutral advisor.



**Delivery health \& efficiency** 



* Keep teams efficient and right\-sized; manage utilisation and cost discipline within the agreed staffing envelope.
* Surface commercial risks (scope creep, change requests, staffing pressure) early to the Practice Head.



  





**Required:** 



* 10\+ years total experience, with 5\+ years in delivery leadership inside a services or consulting model.
* Demonstrated track record running both a large, multi\-team program and parallel engagements — so the flex between the two modes is proven, not aspirational.
* Genuine, hands\-on understanding of agentic and GenAI delivery: evaluations, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop, and the realities of shipping non\-deterministic systems.
* Strong overall technical depth — these are complex, production\-grade agentic AI applications, and the delivery lead must be able to engage credibly on architecture, integration, and engineering trade\-offs, not just process.
* Familiarity with common multi\-agent frameworks and orchestration patterns (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) and the major cloud AI \& data stacks (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Credible data\-platform delivery experience — having shipped a real data foundation (e.g. lakehouse / Fabric / Databricks / Snowflake or equivalent), not just consumed one.
* Solid understanding of business processes and how AI solutions map to real business outcomes — able to connect what the team builds to the value the client is after.
* Track record delivering for large enterprise clients (Fortune 500 / Fortune 100\), with awareness of enterprise security, compliance, and data governance expectations at that scale.
* Strong senior\-stakeholder presence and the ability to say no credibly when scope drifts.
* Player\-coach posture: senior enough to own a portfolio, hands\-on enough to earn the team’s technical respect.



  





**Nice\-to\-have:** 



* Delivery experience across multiple industries (high\-tech, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare).
* Relevant certifications (PMP, SAFe/Agile, cloud or AI platform certifications).
* Exposure to a POD\-based, Forward\-Deployed\-Engineer delivery model.
* Comfort with global clients and time zones, and periodic travel.

2cb0fd72.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
2cb0fd72.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
 Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
   

  

 What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
   

  

**OUR CULTURE**
 Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
   

  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


 If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own execution for large, cross\-functional technical programs at Quince to help us scale and grow in existing geographies or launch new countries. You will work across product, engineering, business, and legal to align on scope, priorities, and dependencies. You will typically work with several engineering teams, product and business counterparts across the globe, and a commercial deadline.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will run several large, cross\-functional programs at a time and be accountable for their delivery, on both timeline and impact.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery, from scoping through launch and post\-launch measurement.
* Work directly with engineering \& product leads and architects on technical/business trade\-offs.
* Drive alignment across US and India teams, including product and business leadership in Pacific time.
* Surface risks early and push for decisions when teams are stuck.
* Communicate status, risk, and asks to senior leadership in clear writing.
* Build the execution mechanisms this team needs as it scales.


**Qualifications** 
**Required:**
* 10\-14 years of experience, with the last several as a TPM on product programs that shipped to customers.
* A bias for ownership. You take charge of ambiguous problems without waiting to be assigned, and you hold your ground with senior stakeholders when you believe the call is wrong.
* A record of owning launches end to end.
* Technical depth. An engineering background, or experience shaping architecture and design decisions.
* Experience running programs across time zones with US or headquarters stakeholders.
* Strong written communication with senior stakeholders.


****Good to have** 
 :**
* E\-commerce, D2C, or marketplace experience
* Exposure to global expansion, localization, or regulatory programs


**WHY QUINCE?**
 Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
   

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**
 Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
 At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

1aedc5db.description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Solution Account Lead (SAL) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end\-to\-end solution area domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. The SAL shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Ownership \& Strategy:** 
 Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
   

  

**Drive End\-to\-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise:** 
 Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high\-priority business challenges. Lead end\-to\-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
   

  

**Pipeline \& Opportunity Management:** 
 Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, contributing to pipeline growth and revenue targets.
   

  

**Product Success \& Innovation:** 
 Drive go\-to\-market for new products, engage early with customers, validate solutions, and influence the product roadmap. Lead AI and innovation initiatives (e.g., BDC, Knowledge Graphs, scalable PoCs, Joule agents).
   

  

**Enablement, Demos \& Prototypes:** 
 Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo \& Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
   

  

**Value Proposition \& Executive Engagement:** 
 Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying\-center challenges to accelerate executive buy\-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
   

  

**Commercial Negotiations:** 
 Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
   

  

**Adoption \& Consumption:** 
 Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS\&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
   

  

**Customer Success \& Field Impact:** 
 Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Relationship Building \& Governance:** 
 Drive C\-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long\-term high\-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
   

  

**Ecosystem \& Partner Engagement:** 
 Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co\-innovate, develop joint go\-to\-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high\-quality relationships with partner account leads.
   

  

**Collaboration \& Orchestration:** 
 Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go\-to\-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
   

  

**Competitive \& Industry Expertise:** 
 Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Competencies**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field.
* Management consulting type profile with 10\-15 Years Industry or Practitioner experience; Executive relationship building skills with proven C\-suite influence.
* B2B enterprise experience with multi\-stakeholder SaaS cycles, plus top\-tier consulting and deep industry expertise.
* Proven experience in account management, solution sales, or customer success roles.
* Strong understanding of solution sales, customer value realization, and account planning methodologies; Expansion selling track record (account growth).
* Deep SAP and domain expertise, with strong understanding of AI and innovation trends.
* Maps value levers and tell a quantified ROI storytelling and compelling business case creation
* Strategic thinking, business acumen, relationship building and client advocacy skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
* 12 plus years’ experience in a quota carrying role
* 5 plus years’ domain experience in Finance \& Spend Management (Procurement / oCFO solutions) domain either from related industry or consulting
* Drive pipeline and deal execution for SAP oCFO solutions in collaboration with account teams.
* Support value\-based discovery and executive conversations with CFO and finance leadership.
* Position SAP oCFO solutions with clear differentiation and business outcomes.
* Act as the oCFO domain specialist supporting sales teams and partners. Execute joint GTM motions with regional, global, and partner teams.
* Proven solution sales / pre\-sales experience in complex enterprise deals.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The SAL is pivotal in shaping SAP’s market leadership by delivering transformative solutions, driving innovation (especially in AI), and orchestrating value across the customer lifecycle. This role is at the intersection of strategy, technology, and relationship management, ensuring customers realize the full value of their SAP investments while positioning the organization for sustained growth.

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. 41616cf0.description:
