849fe762.description:
**Company Description** 
 Gronsol Inverter Technology LLP® is a Make in India solar technology company with over 12 years of experience in the solar manufacturing industry. The company delivers high\-performance on\-grid, hybrid, micro, and lithium energy storage solutions, engineered for India’s climate conditions and installer requirements. Every GronSol inverter is designed, manufactured, and quality\-tested in India by a seasoned technical team, positioning the company as an emerging reliable solar inverter manufacturer. With a strong commitment to Atmanirbhar Bharat, Gronsol invests in R\&D, modern production, and customer\-centric innovation. The company is also recognized for fast service support, making clean energy simpler, smarter, and fully adapted to India’s needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Presales Engineer is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Surat, with some flexibility for work from home. The role involves supporting the sales team with technical expertise on solar inverters and energy storage solutions, including product demonstrations, solution design, and technical presentations for prospective and existing customers. The Technical Presales Engineer will analyze customer requirements, prepare system configurations and proposals, and ensure that recommended solutions are technically sound, cost\-effective, and aligned with Gronsol’s product portfolio. Day\-to\-day tasks include responding to technical queries, preparing documentation and drawings, coordinating with engineering and service teams, and assisting in training partners and installers on product features and best practices. The role also includes gathering market and customer feedback to support product improvement and contributing to presales tools, templates, and knowledge resources.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical foundation in electrical, electronics, or renewable energy engineering, preferably with experience in solar PV systems, inverters, or energy storage solutions.
* Knowledge of system design, load calculations, single\-line diagrams, and basic power electronics concepts relevant to grid\-tied and hybrid inverter technologies.
* Ability to translate technical features into customer\-focused value propositions and to support sales teams during customer meetings, presentations, and negotiations.
* Proficiency in preparing technical proposals, documentation, and reports using standard office tools and, ideally, basic CAD or design software.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage installers, partners, and end customers in a clear, structured, and professional manner.
* Problem\-solving mindset, with a focus on diagnosing technical issues, recommending solutions, and coordinating with service teams for resolution.
* Comfort working in a hybrid environment in Surat, with the ability to collaborate across departments and manage time independently for both on\-site and remote tasks.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Renewable Energy, or related field) is preferred; presales or field experience in solar or power electronics is

* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
   

  

 As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre\-sales agreement shaping and post\-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long\-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise\-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code\-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real\-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer\-facing teams.

**15 to 20 years of experience**  

**Skills: Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Supply Chain Finance, Cloud\-Native Architecture, Microservices, API Design, Event\-Driven Architecture, Payments, Core Banking, TOGAF / ArchiMate, Monolithic to Microservices Migration, Stakeholder Management, ISO 20022, Basel III, Roadmap Planning**

**About the Role**
  

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with 15\+ years of overall experience and 5\+ years in Solution and / or Enterprise Architecture. You will define target state architectures and high\-level designs for Supply Chain Finance — aligned to the bank's strategy and enterprise architecture guidelines — covering all relevant architecture dimensions including business, application, data, and technology. You will work across multiple stakeholder groups, domains, and geographies to deliver end\-to\-end solution designs that meet immediate business outcomes while progressing the long\-term enterprise architecture vision.  

  



**Key Skills and experience:**


* Proficient in defining the target state architecture and high\-level design for the assigned scope based on business outcomes and aligned with the bank's strategy. The target architecture and solution should cover all relevant dimensions – business, application, data and technology architecture.
* Domain \- Proficient in Trade Finance domain along with deep understanding of integration to Payments and Core Banking platform.

* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders across multiple functional areas, domains and geographies, to define the strategic architecture for a given area.
* Analysis of options and delivery of end\-to\-end solution designs using the relevant building blocks making sure the implementation delivers both the immediate business outcomes and moves us towards the longer\-term enterprise architecture outcomes.
* Good communication and negotiation skills
* Preferrable to have knowledge and experience of Industry Architecture Frameworks: TOGAF, ArchiMate etc.
* Preferrable to have knowledge and experience of global and regional regulatory frameworks (e.g., Basel III, PSD2, ISO 20022\).

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Solution Development – Define target state solution architecture, design end\-to\-end architectural views and processes for the given scope.

94d87263.title: Sr. Pricipal, Architect Solutions
94d87263.description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Sr Principal Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
 Pune
   

  

**Job Description AND PrinciplE Responsibilities**
 Senior Solution Architect will architect and guide delivery of solutions that meet strategic and tactical needs across channels and platforms. Will own the technical roadmap, manage technical risks, ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, and partner with engineering and security teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Senior Solution Architect is also responsible to design technical roadmap and processes. Design and develop change resilient application code and execute robust and effective testing. Manage project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters with a product mindset. Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Solution Design
   

  

* Architect solutions to meet strategic/tactical technical needs; drive end\-to\-end solution design for initiatives and enhancements.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements are incorporated into overall solution architecture (e.g., reliability, performance, maintainability, supportability).
* Define interactions between systems/components to optimize functional coverage and integration.


 Roadmap, Risk \& Standards
   

  

* Create and maintain a technical capability roadmap; own technical risks and mitigation approaches associated with features and technologies.
* Ensure alignment with architectures defined within the division and across the enterprise; ensure enterprise technical standards are met.
* Evaluate technologies/products/solutions and recommend introduction, retirement, or phase\-out aligned to roadmap and enterprise direction.


 Security \& Governance
   

  

* Coordinate and address security architecture requirements in partnership with enterprise security teams.
* Support governance/approval readiness by ensuring architecture diagrams reflect implemented reality; ensure monitoring/logging posture and enterprise pipeline usage evidence is in place when required.


 Engineering Leadership \& Collaboration
   

  

* Lead developers in creation/review of new or enhanced software and provide technical guidance through design and implementation decisions.
* Engage business partners to understand requirements; translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Business Architects/Product teams to ensure technical architecture supports business objectives.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure technical standards are defined (as needed) and implemented by the multiple Agile teams in accounting


**Qualifications/ Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 15\+ years of significant experience in solution architecture and delivery in complex environments (multi\-team, cross\-functional).
* 5\+ years in Finance domain, 2\+ in Investment domain within Finance. Custody domains experience a huge plus


**Core Skills**
* Strong solution design skills across application/integration/data/platform layers; ability to make tradeoffs and drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, decision\-making, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks under timelines.
* Ability to drive alignment to enterprise standards and ensure maintainability/supportability of solutions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Experience in modern delivery methods (Agile) and guiding engineering teams through architecture and design decisions.
* Proven skills in building massive scale Cloud Native streaming apps that are resilient and elastically scalable and have built\-in redundancy.
* Experience coordinating security architecture and compliance expectations for enterprise solutions.


**Experience In Tech Stacks**
* Experience in programming languages (preferably Java) with hands\-on coding
* Experience in Azure Cloud, Terraform. Microservices (Container, Docker, Kubernetes, Cosmos DB), Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Warehouse, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL.
* Azure DevOps \- GIT, CI/CD Pipeline / GitActions
* Azure Security and Governance \- Manage Identity, SAS, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Application Gateway, Application Security Group, Web App Security, Dynamic Data Masking
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills with strong interpersonal and team management skills


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

e84d6d27.description:
Job Function: S\&C Delivery The role:

Are you passionate about helping organizations modernize and migrate business\-critical databases to the cloud?
Do you enjoy solving complex database migration challenges across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments?
Would you like to work on large\-scale cloud transformation projects while combining database expertise, customer engagement, and migration delivery?  

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations modernize their data platforms and accelerate cloud adoption through expert consulting and delivery services. We are looking for a Cloud Database Migration DBA to support database transformation initiatives across AWS, Azure, and on\-premises environments, helping customers migrate, optimize, and modernize their database workloads.  

As a Cloud Database Migration DBA, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and executing database migration and modernization projects across cloud and on\-premises environments. Working closely with Cloud Architects, Infrastructure Engineers, Application Teams, Security Specialists, and customer stakeholders, you will ensure successful migration outcomes while minimizing risk, downtime, and business disruption. **Key responsibilities:*** Delivering database migration and modernization projects across on\-premises, AWS, Azure, and managed database platforms.
* Performing database assessments, compatibility reviews, migration planning, sizing recommendations, and technical discovery activities.
* Designing and executing migration approaches, validation plans, cutover strategies, rollback plans, and post\-migration support activities.
* Supporting database administration activities including performance tuning, backup and recovery, replication, security, availability, and disaster recovery.
* Troubleshooting migration issues, replication challenges, connectivity problems, performance bottlenecks, and data consistency concerns.
* Collaborating with customer and project teams to develop migration runbooks, technical documentation, knowledge transfer materials, and successful project outcomes.


What we need to see from you:
* 5 \- 8yrs strong experience working with enterprise database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
* Practical experience delivering cloud database migration projects involving AWS and/or Azure database services.
* Strong understanding of database migration methodologies including assessment, schema conversion, remediation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover execution.
* Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), replication technologies, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and downtime minimization strategies.
* Strong SQL skills, database performance troubleshooting expertise, and experience optimizing database workloads.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer\-facing consulting skills.


Why SoftwareOne?:  

SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI\-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. With a footprint in over 70 countries and a diverse team of 13,000\+ professionals, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talent to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of technology. At the heart of our business is our people. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world\-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose\-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.

674852ff.title: Digital Customer Engagement Manager - SAP Basis, Project Management
674852ff.description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 The digital Customer Engagement Manager (dCEM) is responsible for E2E customer engagement and delivery of contractual agreement and services for SAP Cloud Customers of SAP Global cloud operations, mainly focusing on SAP S/4HANA, private cloud edition deliverables.
   

  

 This role will primarily focus on customer onboarding scenarios, including system migrations and conversions from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA within the SAP private cloud landscape. The dCEM acts as the customer ambassador and primary point of contact, orchestrating migration projects, onboarding activities, and ongoing service delivery while ensuring customer satisfaction and successful adoption of RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The role requires strong SAP technical and migration expertise, combined with customer engagement and project management capabilities, to guide customers through complex cloud transformation journeys into the RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The dCEM oversees the customer lifecycle from the moment of contract signing, particularly customer onboarding, migration activities, continuous service delivery, release and maintenance project initiation, change management, and renewal support for a range of customers. The dCEM is also expected to maintain customer satisfaction through issue mitigation and escalation management and helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with SAP. The dCEM manages a variety of technical and engagement aspects during the various phases of a range of customer’s lifecycle. They will work in seamless collaboration with sales \& pre\-sales team and, SAP Global cloud operations internal delivery teams for the committed scope of delivery throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role also provides expert support in operations and facilitates the service lifecycle.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for driving successful onboarding of customers transitioning to SAP Global Cloud Operations, particularly those undergoing On\-premise to Cloud migrations, ECC to S/4HANA conversions and RISE with SAP transformation programs.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with SAP sales, presales, migration factories, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful execution of migration projects and stable post\-go\-live operations.
   

  

**Key Tasks Comprise The Following**
* Supports sales to delivery handover and supervise the delivery of services outlined in the customer contract.
* Orchestrate customer onboarding and migration activities for Brownfield customers moving to SAP Private Cloud Environment.
* Support downtime optimized migration strategies and coordinate with technical delivery teams to ensure minimal disruption to customer business operations.
* Orchestrates the overall service/project delivery according to planned scope, budget, and milestones.
* Supports critical customer situations in conjunction with Major Incident Management (MIM), SAP Global Cloud Operations Customer Escalation Team and SAP Product Support, as applicable.
* Supports customers on technical requirements throughout their lifecycle within the SAP Global Cloud Operations scope of engagement.
* Monitor project milestones, delivery timelines, and key risks to ensure successful project execution.
* Support customer satisfaction surveys (CSAT)


**What You Bring**
* 5 \- 7 years of work experience as SAP technical consultant with 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role (consulting, IT support, IT services, etc.)
* Hands on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP brownfield migrations, and infrastructure updates for cloud customers.
* Strong experience in SAP system migrations and conversions, particularly SAP system migrations to cloud environments (RISE PCE)
* Hands\-on experience with SAP migration approaches, including conversion : DMO Move to S/4 HANA, SWPM on migration using Backup/Restore, Migration using HANA Replication, and Selective Data Migration.
* Must have exposure to SAP private cloud deployments on Hyperscaler, Azure/ AWS (in context of SAP Green Field and Brown Field Customers)
* Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results\-driven / Self\-organized / Decision making.
* An individual in this role is expected to deliver ‘Effective customer communication’ using digital mediums to achieve high customer satisfaction. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis, and SAP Application.
* Good understanding of ECSs operations infrastructure, processes, and automation tools like SPC, TIC, etc. is a plus.
* Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


**Where You Belong**
 The SAP Global Cloud Operations (GCO) organization is a business unit responsible for providing cloud\-hosted infrastructure and application management services to SAP customers around the world in a 24x7 operations model. Our portfolio of private cloud solutions turns SAP products into a solution\-as\-a\-service on customer’s preferred infrastructure, including Hyperscaler, as one SAP. The portfolio is at the center of the SAP strategy to help customers on their journey to use SAP S/4HANA and become an Intelligent Enterprise.
   

  

 As part of ECS, the SAP Global Cloud Operations Private Cloud Customer Center, or PC3, is a shared services organization dedicated to managing service delivery at scale for high\-volume, low\-touch, private cloud customers.
   

  

 Because we are at the heart of the SAP strategy, our business unit is growing rapidly. In order to facilitate that growth, we are looking for people with diverse technical and customer engagement backgrounds to join our Center of Expertise around the world. You will become part of a great team of smart technical and customer engagement professionals, where there are great opportunities for growth and there is tremendous potential for specialized development of your skills.
   

  

 \#SAPECSCareers \#SAPInternalT2
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
   

  

 Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
   

  

**AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
 For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

e52e22d1.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
e52e22d1.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting\-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.


As a Lead Technical Program Manager in Commercial and Investment Bank technology team, you will drive the successful delivery of complex technology projects and programs that will help reaching business goals across the firm. Leveraging your deep knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential for developing innovative solutions, while simultaneously effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams. Your strong analytical reasoning and adaptability skills will enable you to navigate through ambiguity and change, ensuring that technology initiatives align with business goals. With advanced communication and stakeholder management abilities, you will foster productive working relationships and influence decision\-making to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to the development of operational plans and risk management strategies, ensuring the highest quality and professionalism in service delivery.


**Job responsibilities**


* Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, incorporating technical requirements, resource allocation, and timelines to ensure on\-time delivery of technology solutions
* Identify and mitigate risks, proactively addressing potential roadblocks and implementing contingency plans to maintain project and program momentum
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders, to define program scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall business goals
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate project planning and risk synthesis (e.g., drafting plans, RAID, and status narratives), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
* Promotes reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices for project governance artifacts and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.
* Utilize advanced analytical reasoning to assess program performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement data\-driven optimizations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
* Champion the adoption of agile methodologies and technical solutions, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the team

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization
* Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and influence decision\-making across cross\-functional teams and clients
* Advanced experience in utilizing technical fluency, including knowledge of vendor products and managing vendor relations, to enable on\-demand access to shared pools of applications and services
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technical program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
* Proven track record of effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, agile environment
* Demonstrated proficiency in applying analytical reasoning and problem\-solving techniques to break down business, technical, or operational objectives into manageable tasks and activities

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Experience in the Financial Services industry
* Experience working with Technology Controls
* Experience with Vulnerabilities Management
* Experience with Enterprise Level Infrastructure Technology Programs

Morgan and Chase brands. cb3ea9fb.title: T&T Program Manager
cb3ea9fb.description:
**Job Description**
===================

The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi\-tower programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, workplace, network, data center, and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for transition strategy, governance, execution control, stakeholder alignment, operational readiness, and a smooth handover into steady\-state operations.


The role also requires proven experience in merger and acquisition driven technology transitions, including integration planning, Day\-1 readiness, TSA governance, divestiture support, carve\-out planning, and risk management across acquiring and acquired organizations.


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end transition and transformation programs across multiple service towers, geographies, and customer environments.
* Own transition strategy, mobilization approach, governance model, delivery framework, success criteria, KPIs, and milestone tracking.
* Participate in RFPs, solution shaping, transition estimation, planning assumptions, and customer transition discussions.
* Drive program execution across transition managers, tower leads, solution teams, delivery teams, customer stakeholders, vendors, and partner teams.
* Lead merger, acquisition, divestiture, carve\-out, and separation transition planning, including integration roadmap, Day\-1 readiness, TSA exit plan, risk closure, and controlled handover.

**Core Delivery Areas**
-----------------------

* **Transition Governance:** Establish steering forums, stage\-gate reviews, reporting cadence, escalation paths, RAID controls, and executive decision points.
* **Cloud and Infrastructure Transition:** Oversee cloud migration, hybrid infrastructure, data center services, workplace, network, and managed services transition scope.
* **Cybersecurity Transition:** Govern security operations, identity and access, compliance, GRC, SOC readiness, vulnerability management, and security control transition.
* **M\&A Technology Integration:** Manage infrastructure and security integration, Day\-1 readiness, TSA obligations, service separation, vendor dependencies, licensing impacts, and business acceptance.
* **Commercial and Financial Control:** Track transition budgets, effort estimates, assumptions, dependencies, cost risks, commercial obligations, and value realization.
* **Operational Readiness and Hypercare:** Ensure KT completion, runbook readiness, service acceptance, stabilization, SLA readiness, and handover to steady\-state delivery.

**Qualifications and Certifications**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Business Management.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional or equivalent is preferred.
* Cloud certification in Azure, AWS, or GCP is desirable.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------

* 15\+ years of IT industry experience, with at least 10\+ years in transition, transformation, or complex program management roles.
* Strong experience leading global cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data center, and managed services transitions.
* Proven background in large, multi\-million\-dollar programs involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, and executive sponsors.
* Experience in outsourcing, managed services, digital transformation, and service integration engagements.
* Hands\-on exposure to M\&A technology integration, divestiture, carve\-out, TSA exit, or post\-acquisition infrastructure and security transition programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage geographically distributed teams and work across diverse customer and delivery environments.

**Technical and Functional Skills**
-----------------------------------

* Enterprise transition governance, program management, portfolio assurance, RAID management, and executive reporting.
* Cloud platforms and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, private cloud, and multi\-cloud architectures.
* Infrastructure modernization, workplace transformation, network operations, data center transition, and managed services onboarding.
* Cybersecurity transition planning covering SOC, IAM, GRC, Zero Trust, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and security operations.
* M\&A transition management, TSA governance, service separation, integration planning, vendor transition, licensing impact analysis, and Day\-1 readiness.
* Commercial governance, business case tracking, financial forecasting, value realization, dependency management, and contract\-aligned delivery control.

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Executive presence with strong customer and leadership engagement.
* Clear ownership, accountability, and delivery discipline.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, pressure, and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to align business, technology, security, commercial, and delivery stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex program matters for senior audiences.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Prior experience in global delivery organizations, IT services, consulting, or managed services environments.
* Experience working with customers across BFSI, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, technology, telecom, or public sector domains.
* Exposure to tools such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, and Microsoft 365\.
* Experience working with legal, procurement, finance, HR, security, and compliance teams during M\&A\-led technology transitions.

* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations

6a60ac7f.title: Technical Program Manager
6a60ac7f.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or product delivery background to join our newly established Implementation Management team.
   

  

 In this role, you will independently lead cross\-domain initiatives—ranging from high\-volume platform migrations to regional product launches, remediation projects, and platform onboardings. You will sit within the Servicing organisation, but will align directly with partner product segments outside Servicing, leading cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance.
   

  

 This role demands strong stakeholder management, hands\-on systems curiosity, program management rigour, pattern recognition, and a passion for process
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead Cross\-Domain Initiatives: Take single\-threaded ownership of high\-impact, cross\-squad projects—including core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches, and partner integrations.
* Consult Partners on Platform Integration: Understand the capabilities, integration flows, and limitations of Wise’s Servicing platforms. Guide partner teams through onboarding requirements and help translate business/compliance needs into clear user stories for Implementation Engineers where necessary.
* Drive Pragmatic, Hands\-On Delivery: Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You don't need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions, running API requests in Postman for testing, and creating dashboards or tables in Looker to track metrics.
* Manage Operational Transformation \& Launch Readiness: Work with Business Operations to ensure product launches are fully supported with operational workflows, queue structures, and agent guidance.
* Drive Program Management Lifecycle: Hold the pen on end\-to\-end program governance—authoring clear program briefs, setting SMART objectives, managing risk logs, tracking delivery milestones, and conducting post\-implementation reviews.
* Leave the Place Better Than You Found It: Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, and establish telemetry to scale future execution.


**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ Years of Relevant Experience: Proven track record of delivering cross\-functional technical or operational projects as an Implementation Manager, Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technical Consultant, Product manager or Fintech Delivery Lead.
* Systems Literacy \& Practical Technical Curiosity: Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, ask sharp and challenging questions about technical designs, run Postman calls for testing/validation, and build basic tables/dashboards in Looker or SQL.
* Program Management Excellence: Strong foundation in project/program delivery best practices—from scoping and brief writing to designing governance structures, stakeholder reporting, and post\-implementation audits.
* Exceptional Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication. Ability to adjust messaging seamlessly whether facilitating alignment with product managers, clarifying requirements with engineers, or updating business leaders.
* Pattern Recognition \& Structured Thinking: Ability to absorb unstructured information across disparate domains, spot commonalities, and design standardized, repeatable frameworks.


**What You’ll Benefit From**
* Payments / FinCrime / Platform Exposure: Exposure to Fintech, Payments, Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC), or platform integration projects.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

a2099d77.title: Solution Engineer
a2099d77.description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
 Solution Engineer
   

  

 What We Need
   

  

 Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross\-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
 **Reports to:** 
 Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
   

  

**About Corpay Cross\-Border**
 Corpay Cross\-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
   

  

 As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product\-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross\-border.
   

  

 How We Work
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
   

  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


 Role Overview
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross\-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
   

  

 The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
   

  

 You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad\-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
   

  

 The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
   

  

 Role Responsibilities
   

  

**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
 Client Implementation \& Solutioning
   

  

* Support end\-to\-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go\-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post\-go\-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.


 Technical Analysis \& Troubleshooting
   

  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.


 Global Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.


 Special Projects, Automation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support special and ad\-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client\-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client\-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, file\-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad\-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.


 Benefits \& Perks
   

  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical \& Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness \& Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check\-ups for self and family.
* Tech \& Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute \& Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture \& Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.


**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
 Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
   

  

 At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
   

  

 As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
   

  

**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** 
 Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
   

  

 Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com
   

  

**Transparency \& Compliance**
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.
   

  

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring**
 Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
   

  

**Candidate Privacy Notice**
 For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy\-policy.
   

  

**Pay Philosophy**
 Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job\-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

f2c9c2e7.description:
**Posted On:** 29 Sept 2026


**Location:** Noida, UP, India


**Company:** Iris Software


**Why Join Iris?**  

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of **India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry**? Do you want to grow in an award\-winning culture that **truly values your talent and ambitions**?
  

Join Iris Software — one of the **fastest\-growing IT services companies** — where **you own and shape your success story**.
**About Us**  

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.
With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology\-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation \& logistics, and professional services.
Our work covers complex, mission\-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high\-value complex Application \& Product Engineering, Data \& Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data \& MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.  

  

  

**Working with Us**  

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.
Our Employee Value Proposition, **“Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.”** reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.
We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting\-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.
Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.
**Job Description**
-------------------


We are looking for a GenAI Architect to design, build, and guide the implementation of Generative AI solutions across enterprise use cases. The role requires strong hands\-on and architectural expertise in LLMs, RAG, vector databases, and agentic AI frameworks, along with experience in cloud\-native deployments and CI/CD automation. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, data/ML teams, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and production\-ready GenAI platforms and applications.


**Key Responsibilities**


Architect and design end\-to\-end GenAI solutions including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and multimodal use cases.
  

Translate business problems into GenAI\-driven use cases, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmaps.
  

Design and implement retrieval systems using embeddings, chunking strategies, metadata filters, reranking, and evaluation metrics.
  

Select and integrate vector databases and optimize indexing, retrieval performance, and relevance tuning.
  

Build agentic systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and related orchestration tools.
  

Define cloud architecture patterns for scalable, secure, and reliable GenAI deployments.
  

Drive productionization using CI/CD pipelines, containerization using best practices.
  

Ensure responsible AI practices including security, governance, privacy, compliance, and monitoring.
  

Provide technical leadership, reviews, mentoring, and best\-practice guidance to engineering teams.
  

Collaborate with product and delivery teams to ensure solution alignment with timelines and business outcomes.


**Primary Skills (Must Have)**


GenAI / LLM Architecture \& Algorithms


Strong knowledge of GenAI algorithms and LLM concepts: prompting, fine\-tuning vs RAG, embeddings, context windows, token limits, hallucination control.
  

Experience designing enterprise GenAI use cases (document Q\&A, copilots, summarization, search, workflow automation, customer support, knowledge assistants).
  

Understanding of evaluation techniques: groundedness, relevance, faithfulness, latency/cost trade\-offs.


Vector Databases \& Retrieval Systems


Hands\-on understanding of vector databases and similarity search concepts:
  

embeddings, indexing, ANN search, hybrid search, metadata filtering
  

Experience with tools like Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, Azure AI Search / Elastic (vector) (any relevant combination).


Agentic AI Frameworks


Strong working knowledge of agentic frameworks such as:
  

LangChain
  

LangGraph
  

MCP
  

Tool calling / function calling, memory, planning, multi\-agent workflows, guardrails


Cloud Architecture \& Deployments


Experience with cloud services and architecture for GenAI workloads:
  

compute, networking, storage, IAM/security, logging/monitoring
  

Knowledge of cloud components supporting AI/ML solutions (managed services preferred).


CI/CD and Productionization


Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for GenAI apps and services.
  

Strong understanding of deployment patterns:
  

containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), API deployment, model endpoint integration
  

Familiarity with DevOps/MLOps practices: testing, observability, rollback, scaling, cost controls.

  

**Mandatory Competencies**
--------------------------


Data Science and Machine Learning \- Data Science and Machine Learning \- Gen AI
Beh \- Communication
Development Tools and Management \- Development Tools and Management \- CI/CD
Cloud \- GCP \- Apigee API Management, API Gateway
**Perks and Benefits for Irisians**  

Iris provides world\-class benefits for a personalized employee experience. These benefits are designed to support financial, health and well\-being needs of Irisians for a holistic professional and personal growth. Click here to view the benefits.

 »

4d1f39aa.title: IT Architect (Azure Cloud Architect)
4d1f39aa.description:
****Career Area:****
 Technology, Digital and Data
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****About Caterpillar****
 Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off\-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel\-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced\-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.
   

  

**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****Job Summary****
 We are seeking a skilled
 **IT Architect (Azure Cloud Architect** 
 ) to join
 **Azure Platform Services \-CAT IT Division**
 The preference for this role is to be based out of
 **Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
****What You Will Do****
* Architect and design applications that run on Azure China/21Vianet and Commercial clouds by providing technical expertise and guidance in cloud technologies.
* Work with GCIO teams to champion the Azure services available and how they can enable the business to run more efficiently in Azure.
* Lead migrations from on\-premise deployments to Azure cloud environment.
* Work with the Principal Architects and IT Teams to develop roadmaps for Azure cloud services.
* Work with the IT Security team on analysis and security architecture for major initiatives.
* Work with other IT teams to establish, design, and support an enterprise cloud architecture that provides the required capacity plans and supports the long\-term strategic goals for enterprise cloud technologies.
* Lead and perform development, automation, and deployment assignments without close supervision.
* Complete technical evaluation of Azure cloud services for general on\-boarding including aligning service capabilities to business requirements, reference architecture designs, and controls to securely deploy solutions.
* Assist with documentation, training, and usability efforts.


****What You Will Have****
* Strong IT infrastructure and/or software development experience, especially in networking, application services, and distributed computing.
* Technical leadership or lead developer experience.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud architecture, systems design, application design, and development.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience automating infrastructure or application deployments using PowerShell, Python, Java, NodeJS, .NET, JSON, or YAML.
* Strong English communication, teamwork, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and customer service skills.
* This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.


****Top Candidates Will Also Have:****
* Microsoft Azure Certification(s) such as: AZ\-305, AZ\-500, AZ\-104, AZ\-900, AZ\-204, or AZ\-400
* Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tools such as Azure DevOps
* Experience with the Azure Portal, CLI, PowerShell cmdlets, and/or REST APIs
* Experience using the Agile methodology
* Experience designing and/or building Azure solutions including web\-based UI or API applications, IoT solutions, data pipelines, or machine learning/AI capabilities.
* Experience working with corporate security on infrastructure or applications security compliance and remediation activities (e.g, Risk Acceptance, Security Configuration Baseline)


****Skills Desired:****
**Core Application Systems: Knowledge** 
 of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Manages application\-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.

10eb142f.title: Solutions Development Architect
10eb142f.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring


**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**
* Bachelor or advanced degree
* Demonstrated experience designing business\-driven, standards\-based, future\-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes
* Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

**Technical Skills**

* In\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas
* Proficiency in creating Conceptual \& Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products
* Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments

**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives
* Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions
* With a global team and the main stakeholders in NALA and EMEA the position requires regular availability for meetings outside of standard business hours
* Availability to travel up to 20% of the time


**Shift:** 
 CET time zone
   

  

 \#Hyderabad2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
